2f1c63244936.en: This picture was made by the program we build in this part. <bookmark mark='a'/> With one path of light per pixel it is mostly noise. Each pixel's colour is a random estimate of how much light reaches it, bounced around a box with a red wall, a green wall, a mirror ball and a light in the ceiling. <bookmark mark='b'/> With four paths the shapes appear; with sixteen the colours; <bookmark mark='c'/> with two hundred and fifty-six it is nearly clean, and the soft shadows and the red light spilling onto the white ball are not painted on: they come out of the physics. <bookmark mark='d'/> The error falls like one over the square root of the number of paths, the Monte Carlo rate of Part 20, so four times the work halves the noise.
2f1c63244936.zh: 这幅图是由我们在这一部分构建的程序生成的。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个像素只有一条光路时，它几乎全是噪声。每个像素的颜色，是对有多少光到达它的一次随机估计，这些光在一个盒子里四处反弹：盒子有一面红墙、一面绿墙、一个镜面球，天花板上还有一盏灯。<bookmark mark='b'/>有4条光路时，形状出现了；16条时，颜色出现了；<bookmark mark='c'/>256条时，它几乎干净了，而那些柔和的阴影，以及洒到白球上的红光，都不是画上去的：它们来自物理。<bookmark mark='d'/>误差按光路数的平方根分之一下降，这是第20部分的蒙特卡洛收敛速度，所以工作量变成4倍，噪声就减半。

b4300da22256.en: There are two ways to turn a scene into pixels, and this part builds both. <bookmark mark='a'/> Rasterization takes each triangle, projects its corners onto the screen with linear algebra and one division, and fills in the pixels it covers, here blending three colours across one triangle. Games and user interfaces work this way, sixty or more times a second. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ray tracing works backwards: from the eye, through each pixel, into the scene, bouncing off mirrors and through glass. This small image took 41,563 rays. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ivan Sutherland's Sketchpad drew lines on a screen in 1963. Turner Whitted traced recursive rays in 1980. The mathematics between them is the subject of this part.
b4300da22256.zh: 把一个场景变成像素有两种方法，这一部分两种都会构建。<bookmark mark='a'/>光栅化取出每个三角形，用线性代数加一次除法把它的角投影到屏幕上，再填满它覆盖的像素，这里是在一个三角形上混合三种颜色。游戏和用户界面就是这样工作的，每秒60次甚至更多。<bookmark mark='b'/>光线追踪反过来工作：从眼睛出发，穿过每个像素，进入场景，在镜子上反弹，穿过玻璃。这幅小图用了41563条光线。<bookmark mark='c'/>1963年，Ivan Sutherland 的 Sketchpad 在屏幕上画出了线条。1980年，Turner Whitted 追踪了递归的光线。这两者之间的数学，就是这一部分的主题。

38cbecdab484.en: This is Part 51 of Computer Science, Built, and the first part of Act Ten, Horizons and Trust. <bookmark mark='a'/> We will transform and project geometry; rasterize it with a depth buffer and perspective-correct interpolation; shade it and texture it without aliasing; trace rays through a bounding volume hierarchy; derive the rendering equation and solve it by path tracing; and finish with the curves that draw every letter you have read in this series.
38cbecdab484.zh: 这是计算机科学，从零搭建，第51部分，也是第十幕“视野与信任”的第一部分。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们将变换并投影几何体；用深度缓冲区和透视校正插值把它光栅化；给它着色、贴上纹理，而且不产生混叠；让光线穿过包围体层次结构；推导渲染方程，并用路径追踪求解它；最后讲那些曲线，它们画出了你在这个系列里读到的每一个字母。

8cfab8060b8d.en: A scene is made of points, and a renderer's first job is to move them: each object into the world, and the world in front of the camera. <bookmark mark='a'/> A matrix moves every point at once. Its columns say where the two axis arrows land, and because the map is linear, everything else follows. <bookmark mark='b'/> Rotations, scalings and shears all work this way, and one after another is a single matrix, their product. <bookmark mark='c'/> But a linear map never moves the origin, so the simplest motion of all, sliding sideways, is not a matrix of this size.
8cfab8060b8d.zh: 一个场景由点组成，渲染器的第一项工作就是移动它们：把每个物体放进世界，再把世界摆到相机前面。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个矩阵一次移动所有的点。它的列说明两个坐标轴箭头落在哪里，而因为这个映射是线性的，其他一切都随之确定。<bookmark mark='b'/>旋转、缩放和剪切都是这样工作的，而一个接一个地做，就是单独一个矩阵，也就是它们的乘积。<bookmark mark='c'/>但线性映射从不移动原点，所以最简单的运动，也就是向旁边滑动，不是这种大小的矩阵能做到的。

4c3ea2d24d93.en: The fix is to add one coordinate. <bookmark mark='a'/> A general motion is a matrix times the point, plus a constant. <bookmark mark='b'/> Give every point an extra coordinate, w, equal to one, and put the constant in a new last column: the matrix multiplies that one and adds the translation for us. <bookmark mark='c'/> Here is the picture one dimension down. Points live on the line where w is one. A shear of the plane keeps the origin fixed, as linear maps must, yet slides the line along itself: a translation. <bookmark mark='d'/> These are August Möbius's homogeneous coordinates of 1827. Directions get w equal to zero, so they turn but never move.
4c3ea2d24d93.zh: 办法是增加一个坐标。<bookmark mark='a'/>一般的运动是矩阵乘以点，再加上一个常数。<bookmark mark='b'/>给每个点一个额外的坐标 w，令它等于1，并把这个常数放进新的最后一列：矩阵乘以那个1，就替我们加上了平移。<bookmark mark='c'/>这是降一维之后的图景。点都住在 w 等于1的那条直线上。平面的一个剪切保持原点不动，线性映射必须如此，但它让这条直线沿着自身滑动：这就是一次平移。<bookmark mark='d'/>这就是 August Möbius 在1827年提出的齐次坐标。方向的 w 等于零，所以它们会转动，却从不移动。

7febfa60cf71.en: Now a chain of motions multiplies into one matrix. But matrix products do not commute, and they act from right to left. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the left, the unit square is rotated a quarter turn, then moved two units right. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the right, the same two matrices in the other order: moved first, then swung around the origin. <bookmark mark='c'/> The corners, computed by our transform module, land in different places. <bookmark mark='d'/> A renderer multiplies three such matrices: the model matrix places an object in the world, the view matrix puts the world in front of the camera, and the projection matrix, next chapter, prepares perspective.
7febfa60cf71.zh: 现在，一串运动相乘就成了一个矩阵。但矩阵乘法不满足交换律，而且它们从右往左作用。<bookmark mark='a'/>左边，单位正方形先旋转四分之一圈，再向右移动两个单位。<bookmark mark='b'/>右边，同样两个矩阵换个次序：先移动，再绕原点甩过去。<bookmark mark='c'/>由我们的变换模块算出的角点，落在了不同的地方。<bookmark mark='d'/>渲染器要乘三个这样的矩阵：模型矩阵把物体放进世界，视图矩阵把世界摆到相机前面，而投影矩阵，也就是下一章的内容，为透视做准备。

2f1eb70031ff.en: Rotations in three dimensions are usually described by three angles: yaw, pitch and roll. <bookmark mark='a'/> Watch the roll axis as the pitch rises. At ninety degrees it lies along the yaw axis: yaw and roll now spin about the same line, and one way of turning is gone. This is gimbal lock. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our transform module measures it: the singular values of the map from angle rates to spin are one, and the square roots of one plus and one minus the sine of the pitch. <bookmark mark='c'/> At eighty-nine degrees the smallest is about one hundredth; at ninety, zero, and the rank falls to two.
2f1eb70031ff.zh: 三维空间里的旋转通常用三个角来描述：偏航、俯仰和滚转。<bookmark mark='a'/>看着俯仰角增大时的滚转轴。到90度时，它与偏航轴重合：偏航和滚转现在绕同一条线旋转，一种转动方式消失了。这就是万向节锁。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的变换模块测量了它：从角度变化率到转动的映射，其奇异值是1，以及1加、1减俯仰角正弦的平方根。<bookmark mark='c'/>在89度时，最小的那个约为百分之一；在90度时为零，秩降到了2。

f2b58d296f6a.en: The cure is older than computers. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1843 William Rowan Hamilton found numbers with three imaginary units whose squares are all minus one. <bookmark mark='b'/> A turn by theta about an axis is the unit quaternion of cosine and sine of half the angle. <bookmark mark='c'/> To rotate a vector, multiply by q on one side and its conjugate on the other. <bookmark mark='d'/> Euler angles are compact but singular. A matrix has nine numbers, which Part 4's rounding slowly pushes away from a rotation. A quaternion has four, never locks, and is repaired by dividing by its length.
f2b58d296f6a.zh: 解药比计算机还要古老。<bookmark mark='a'/>1843年，威廉·罗文·哈密顿找到了一种数，它有三个虚数单位，平方都等于负1。<bookmark mark='b'/>绕一根轴转过角 θ，就是由半角的余弦和正弦构成的单位四元数。<bookmark mark='c'/>要旋转一个向量，就在一侧乘以 q，在另一侧乘以它的共轭。<bookmark mark='d'/>欧拉角紧凑，却有奇点。一个矩阵有九个数，第4部分讲的舍入会慢慢把它推离旋转。四元数只有四个数，从不锁死，而且只要除以它的长度就能修复。

f15b535a6e21.en: Quaternions also answer the animator's question: how do you turn smoothly between two orientations? <bookmark mark='a'/> The naive way slides the three Euler angles in straight lines, and the nose wanders along this red path. <bookmark mark='b'/> Ken Shoemake's slerp, from 1985, follows the great circle between the two quaternions, with these sine weights. <bookmark mark='c'/> The green path turns the same amount every step, and its total is exactly the single rotation between the ends, about one hundred and thirty-nine degrees. <bookmark mark='d'/> The Euler path turns about two hundred and thirty-seven, unevenly. That is why game engines interpolate rotations with quaternions.
f15b535a6e21.zh: 四元数还回答了动画师的问题：怎样在两个朝向之间平滑地转动？<bookmark mark='a'/>朴素的做法让三个欧拉角沿直线滑动，于是鼻尖沿着这条红色路径游移。<bookmark mark='b'/>Ken Shoemake 在1985年提出的 slerp，也就是球面线性插值，沿着两个四元数之间的大圆走，用的是这些正弦权重。<bookmark mark='c'/>绿色路径每一步转过相同的角度，总量恰好是两端之间那单独一次旋转，大约139度。<bookmark mark='d'/>欧拉角路径大约转了237度，而且不均匀。这就是游戏引擎用四元数来插值旋转的原因。

b4024a476c81.en: Why do far things look small? Leon Battista Alberti wrote down the painter's answer in 1435, and it is similar triangles. <bookmark mark='a'/> Put the eye at the origin and a screen at distance n. A point at height y and distance d is seen along this line, which crosses the screen at height y prime. <bookmark mark='b'/> The small triangle and the large one have the same angles, so y prime over n equals y over d. <bookmark mark='c'/> Multiply through: y prime is n y over d. <bookmark mark='d'/> Twice as far, half as tall. Every coordinate is divided by depth, and division is not linear, so no matrix can do it alone.
b4024a476c81.zh: 为什么远处的东西看起来小？1435年，Leon Battista Alberti 写下了画家的答案，那就是相似三角形。<bookmark mark='a'/>把眼睛放在原点，把一块屏幕放在距离 n 处。一个高度为 y、距离为 d 的点，是沿着这条线被看到的，这条线在高度 y 撇处穿过屏幕。<bookmark mark='b'/>小三角形和大三角形的角相同，所以 y 撇比 n 等于 y 比 d。<bookmark mark='c'/>两边同乘：y 撇等于 n 乘 y 除以 d。<bookmark mark='d'/>远一倍，矮一半。每个坐标都要除以深度，而除法不是线性的，所以没有哪个矩阵能单独做到这一点。

afa8586116c3.en: The fourth coordinate rescues us. <bookmark mark='a'/> The projection matrix scales x and y by the focal factor, and its last row copies the distance into w. Nothing has been divided yet: these are clip coordinates. <bookmark mark='b'/> The hardware then divides by w, once per vertex, and that one division is all of perspective. <bookmark mark='c'/> The third row must keep depth for the depth buffer. After the division it is minus A plus B over d. <bookmark mark='d'/> Ask that the near plane land at minus one and the far plane at plus one, <bookmark mark='e'/> and solve. <bookmark mark='f'/> Stored depth is affine in one over the distance, not in the distance, and that will cost us precision.
afa8586116c3.zh: 第四个坐标救了我们。<bookmark mark='a'/>投影矩阵用焦距因子缩放 x 和 y，它的最后一行把距离复制进 w。这时还什么都没有除：这些是裁剪坐标。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后硬件除以 w，每个顶点一次，而这一次除法就是透视的全部。<bookmark mark='c'/>第三行必须为深度缓冲区保留深度。除法之后，它是负 A 加上 B 除以 d。<bookmark mark='d'/>要求近平面落在负1，远平面落在正1，<bookmark mark='e'/>然后求解。<bookmark mark='f'/>存下来的深度是距离倒数的仿射函数，而不是距离的仿射函数，这会让我们付出精度的代价。

86a3d1db4e41.en: <bookmark mark='a'/> Here is what the matrix and the division do to space. This is the frustum, the truncated pyramid the camera sees between the near and far planes, with three equally spaced slices. <bookmark mark='b'/> Apply the map a little at a time. The far face shrinks and the near face grows, until the frustum is a cube from minus one to one in every coordinate. <bookmark mark='c'/> Straight lines stay straight all the way. <bookmark mark='d'/> But look at the slices: equally spaced in the world, they crowd towards the far face. <bookmark mark='e'/> Triangles are clipped before the division, while everything is still linear, and the cube is finally stretched onto the pixels.
86a3d1db4e41.zh: <bookmark mark='a'/>这就是矩阵和除法对空间做的事。这是视锥体，也就是相机在近平面和远平面之间看到的那个截头棱锥，里面有三个等间距的切片。<bookmark mark='b'/>把这个映射一点一点地施加上去。远端的面缩小，近端的面增大，直到视锥体变成一个在每个坐标上都从负1到1的立方体。<bookmark mark='c'/>直线自始至终保持笔直。<bookmark mark='d'/>但看看这些切片：在世界里它们等间距，现在却挤向远端的面。<bookmark mark='e'/>三角形在除法之前被裁剪，那时一切仍是线性的，最后这个立方体被拉伸到像素上。

9dc59e5ccd69.en: How much does that crowding matter? <bookmark mark='a'/> Plot stored depth against distance, for a near plane at a tenth of a unit and a far plane at a thousand. <bookmark mark='b'/> Half of the whole range is used up before twice the near distance, and ninety percent before distance one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Depth buffers store integers. Picture one with only four bits: its sixteen values sit at sixteen over sixteen minus k. Half of them lie before distance two. <bookmark mark='d'/> And a single step covers the whole back half of the scene, from eight to sixteen.
9dc59e5ccd69.zh: 这种拥挤有多要紧？<bookmark mark='a'/>画出存储的深度随距离变化的曲线，近平面在0.1个单位，远平面在1000。<bookmark mark='b'/>整个范围的一半，在距离达到近平面距离的两倍之前就用掉了，百分之90在距离1之前就用掉了。<bookmark mark='c'/>深度缓冲区存储的是整数。设想一个只有4位的缓冲区：它的16个值位于16除以16减 k 处。其中一半落在距离2之前。<bookmark mark='d'/>而单单一级就覆盖了场景的整个后半部分，从8到16。

025c774f4cf1.en: How close can two surfaces be before the buffer cannot tell them apart? <bookmark mark='a'/> Our transform module finds the smallest resolvable gap for a twenty-four-bit buffer by bisection, and checks it against a closed form. <bookmark mark='b'/> With the near plane at a hundredth of a unit, two surfaces at distance a thousand must be about six units apart. With it at one, six hundredths will do. <bookmark mark='c'/> The closed form says why: the gap grows with the square of the distance and shrinks in proportion to the near distance, while the far plane hardly matters. So the cheapest fix is not more bits: it is pushing the near plane out.
025c774f4cf1.zh: 两个表面要靠得多近，缓冲区才分不清它们？<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的变换模块用二分法找出24位缓冲区能分辨的最小间隙，并用一个闭式公式来核对。<bookmark mark='b'/>近平面在0.01个单位时，距离1000处的两个表面必须相隔大约6个单位。近平面在1时，0.06个单位就够了。<bookmark mark='c'/>闭式公式说明了原因：间隙随距离的平方增长，并与近平面距离成反比地缩小，而远平面几乎无关紧要。所以最便宜的修复不是更多的位，而是把近平面往外推。

3574d930ac02.en: When two surfaces are closer than that gap, their depths round to the same integer, and drawing order decides which one shows. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our module draws two planes a hundredth of a unit apart at distance fifty. <bookmark mark='b'/> With a sixteen-bit buffer and the near plane at a hundredth, ninety-nine percent of the pixels show the wrong plane. Twenty-four bits cut it to about a third. <bookmark mark='c'/> Moving the near plane out to one helps less on its own, to about seventy percent; with both, every pixel is right. <bookmark mark='d'/> Modern engines also store depth reversed, in floating point, so that the dense floats near zero of Part 4 land on the distant geometry that needs them.
3574d930ac02.zh: 当两个表面比这个间隙更近时，它们的深度会舍入到同一个整数，于是由绘制顺序决定哪一个露出来。<bookmark mark='a'/>我们的模块在距离50处画两个相隔0.01个单位的平面。<bookmark mark='b'/>用16位缓冲区，近平面在0.01时，百分之99的像素显示了错误的平面。24位把它降到大约三分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>单把近平面移到1，帮助要小一些，降到大约百分之70；两者一起，每个像素都正确。<bookmark mark='d'/>现代引擎还把深度反过来存储，并且用浮点数，这样第4部分讲的、在零附近密集的浮点数，就落在了需要它们的远处几何体上。

3cfdadf72cee.en: Chapter three. Rasterization and the z-buffer.
3cfdadf72cee.zh: 第三章：光栅化与 z 缓冲区。

9c55b3acc659.en: Which pixels does a triangle cover? <bookmark mark='a'/> For an edge from a to b, take the cross product of the edge with the vector to a point p: twice the signed area of the triangle a, b, p, Part 22's orientation test, telling which side of the edge p is on. <bookmark mark='b'/> Test every pixel centre against the three edges in turn. A centre on the wrong side of any edge is out; the rest are in, and a tie-breaking rule gives a centre exactly on a shared edge to one triangle only. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each edge function is affine, so one pixel to the right adds a constant, and hardware tests whole blocks at once. <bookmark mark='d'/> About half the bounding box was inside.
9c55b3acc659.zh: 一个三角形覆盖哪些像素？<bookmark mark='a'/>对一条从 a 到 b 的边，取这条边与指向点 p 的向量的叉积：它是三角形 a、b、p 有向面积的两倍，也就是第22部分的方向测试，告诉我们 p 在边的哪一侧。<bookmark mark='b'/>把每个像素中心依次对三条边做测试。一个中心只要在任何一条边的错误一侧，就在外面；其余的在里面，而一条打破平局的规则，把恰好落在公共边上的中心只分给一个三角形。<bookmark mark='c'/>每个边函数都是仿射的，所以向右移一个像素就是加一个常数，硬件一次测试整块像素。<bookmark mark='d'/>包围盒里大约一半在内部。

0a957cfb2e4f.en: Once a pixel is inside, we need its colour, its depth, its texture position: values given only at the three corners. <bookmark mark='a'/> A point p splits the triangle into three smaller ones. The share of the area opposite each corner is that corner's weight, lambda, and the three weights add to one. <bookmark mark='b'/> Move p around and watch: near a corner, that corner's weight approaches one. These are barycentric coordinates, from August Möbius in 1827 again, and they come free from the edge functions we already computed. <bookmark mark='c'/> Any value at the corners is blended with the same weights. <bookmark mark='d'/> Give the corners pure red, green and blue, and our rasterizer paints the weights themselves.
0a957cfb2e4f.zh: 一旦某个像素在内部，我们就需要它的颜色、它的深度、它的纹理位置：这些值只在三个角上给出。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个点 p 把三角形分成三个更小的三角形。每个角对面那一块所占的面积份额，就是这个角的权重 λ，三个权重加起来等于1。<bookmark mark='b'/>移动 p 看看：靠近一个角时，那个角的权重趋近于1。这就是重心坐标，同样来自1827年的 August Möbius，而且它们可以从我们已经算出的边函数里免费得到。<bookmark mark='c'/>角上的任何值，都用同样的权重来混合。<bookmark mark='d'/>给三个角纯红、纯绿和纯蓝，我们的光栅化器画出的就是这些权重本身。

9c5dd1b58a5a.en: There is a catch, and it is perspective. <bookmark mark='a'/> Equal steps across the screen are not equal steps across a floor that recedes from the eye. The point halfway between two vertices on the screen is much nearer than the point halfway along the floor. <bookmark mark='b'/> So blending a texture coordinate by screen fractions is wrong. <bookmark mark='c'/> What is right? On a flat triangle, one over the depth is an affine function of screen position: divide the plane's equation by depth to see it. So is any attribute divided by depth. <bookmark mark='d'/> So interpolate u over w and one over w, both linearly, <bookmark mark='e'/> and divide one by the other at every pixel. That division is perspective-correct interpolation.
9c5dd1b58a5a.zh: 这里有个陷阱，那就是透视。<bookmark mark='a'/>在屏幕上走相等的步长，并不是在一块向远处延伸的地板上走相等的步长。屏幕上两个顶点之间的中点，比地板上沿途的中点近得多。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以按屏幕上的比例来混合纹理坐标是错的。<bookmark mark='c'/>什么才是对的？在一个平的三角形上，深度的倒数是屏幕位置的仿射函数：把平面方程除以深度就能看出来。任何属性除以深度也是如此。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以对 u 除以 w 和1除以 w 都做线性插值，<bookmark mark='e'/>并在每个像素上用其中一个除以另一个。这次除法就是透视校正插值。

5831255110f0.en: Here is the difference, from our own rasterizer. <bookmark mark='a'/> A checkered floor made of two triangles, with texture coordinates interpolated affinely: the squares bend along the diagonal where the triangles meet, and almost half of the floor's pixels get the wrong colour. <bookmark mark='b'/> With one over w, every pixel is right. <bookmark mark='c'/> And against a ray cast of the true floor, the texture coordinates agree to rounding error. <bookmark mark='d'/> The original PlayStation, in 1994, skipped this division, and its textures famously wobbled.
5831255110f0.zh: 这是两者的区别，来自我们自己的光栅化器。<bookmark mark='a'/>一块由两个三角形组成的棋盘格地板，纹理坐标用仿射方式插值：方格沿着两个三角形相接的对角线弯折，地板上将近一半的像素得到了错误的颜色。<bookmark mark='b'/>用上1除以 w，每个像素都正确。<bookmark mark='c'/>而与对真实地板做的光线投射相比，纹理坐标在舍入误差之内一致。<bookmark mark='d'/>1994年最初的 PlayStation 省掉了这次除法，它的纹理以晃动而出名。

f7e8a8f1e140.en: Now visibility: which of two overlapping triangles do we see? <bookmark mark='a'/> These two pass through each other, so each is in front over part of the overlap. <bookmark mark='b'/> The painter's algorithm sorts whole triangles from back to front. The blue one is farther on average, so it is painted first and covered everywhere: four hundred and seventy-two pixels wrong. No order of whole triangles can be right. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ed Catmull's answer, in 1974, was a depth for every pixel: a fragment is written only if it is nearer than what is there. <bookmark mark='d'/> The result is right in any drawing order, for one number per pixel, a price steep in 1974 and trivial today.
f7e8a8f1e140.zh: 现在是可见性：两个相互重叠的三角形，我们看到的是哪一个？<bookmark mark='a'/>这两个彼此穿插，所以在重叠区域里，各自有一部分在前面。<bookmark mark='b'/>画家算法把整个三角形从后到前排序。蓝色的那个平均更远，所以它先被画，然后处处被盖住：472个像素是错的。整个三角形无论按什么顺序画，都不可能对。<bookmark mark='c'/>Ed Catmull 在1974年的答案，是给每个像素一个深度：一个片元只有比那里已有的更近时，才会被写入。<bookmark mark='d'/>无论绘制顺序如何，结果都是对的，代价是每个像素一个数，这在1974年很昂贵，在今天则微不足道。

07c7aa8d8669.en: Put together, this is our rasterizer. <bookmark mark='a'/> Vertices arrive in clip coordinates. Triangles are clipped against the near plane while still homogeneous, so nothing behind the eye is ever divided by a negative w. Then the division, the viewport, the edge functions, the depth test, and the perspective-correct blend. <bookmark mark='b'/> One detail matters more than it looks: vertices are snapped to a two-hundred-and-fifty-sixth of a pixel, as GPUs do, so the edge tests are exact, and two triangles sharing an edge never leave a crack between them. <bookmark mark='c'/> Every image in this chapter, and the next two, came out of this pipeline.
07c7aa8d8669.zh: 把这些放在一起，就是我们的光栅化器。<bookmark mark='a'/>顶点以裁剪坐标到达。三角形在仍是齐次的时候就对近平面做裁剪，所以眼睛后面的任何东西，都永远不会被一个负的 w 除。然后是除法、视口、边函数、深度测试，以及透视校正的混合。<bookmark mark='b'/>有一个细节比看上去更重要：顶点被对齐到256分之一像素，就像 GPU 做的那样，所以边测试是精确的，两个共享一条边的三角形之间永远不会留下裂缝。<bookmark mark='c'/>这一章以及接下来两章里的每一幅图，都出自这条流水线。

e432e8cff60f.en: Now that we know which triangle a pixel sees, how bright should it be? <bookmark mark='a'/> Start with a beam of light falling straight onto a matte surface. <bookmark mark='b'/> Tilt the light. The same beam now spreads over a longer stretch of surface, one over the cosine of the angle as long, so each bit of surface receives less, in proportion to the cosine. Johann Heinrich Lambert wrote this down in 1760. <bookmark mark='c'/> The power per unit area is the power over the area, and the area grows as one over the cosine. <bookmark mark='d'/> So brightness goes as the cosine, which is the dot product of the unit normal with the unit vector towards the light. <bookmark mark='e'/> A matte surface scatters that light equally in all directions, so it looks the same from anywhere: here is our sphere with diffuse light alone.
e432e8cff60f.zh: 既然我们知道一个像素看到的是哪个三角形，它该有多亮？<bookmark mark='a'/>从一束光垂直照到一个哑光表面上开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>把光倾斜。同一束光现在铺开在更长的一段表面上，长度是原来的余弦分之一，所以每一小块表面接收到的光更少，与余弦成正比。Johann Heinrich Lambert 在1760年写下了这一点。<bookmark mark='c'/>单位面积上的功率，是功率除以面积，而面积按余弦分之一增长。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以亮度随余弦变化，也就是单位法线与指向光源的单位向量的点积。<bookmark mark='e'/>哑光表面把这些光均匀地散射到所有方向，所以从哪里看都一样：这是只有漫反射光的我们的球。

48d0eb126037.en: Shiny surfaces add a highlight, and in 1975 Bui Tuong Phong, at Utah, gave the model still taught first. <bookmark mark='a'/> Reflect the light direction in the normal. Its projection onto the normal is N dot L times N; go there twice and step back by L, and you have the mirror direction R. <bookmark mark='b'/> The highlight is brightest when the eye looks straight down R, and falls off as the cosine between R and the view direction, raised to a power s. <bookmark mark='c'/> A larger power makes a tighter lobe and a smaller, sharper highlight, a shinier material. <bookmark mark='d'/> Add an ambient constant for light from everywhere else, the diffuse term and the highlight, and this is our rasterizer's sphere, with the power at thirty-two.
48d0eb126037.zh: 有光泽的表面会多出一个高光，1975年，犹他大学的 Bui Tuong Phong 给出了至今仍最先讲授的模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>把光的方向关于法线做反射。它在法线上的投影是 N 点乘 L 再乘 N；走到那里两次，再退回一个 L，就得到镜面方向 R。<bookmark mark='b'/>当眼睛正对着 R 看下去时，高光最亮，并随着 R 与视线方向夹角的余弦衰减，这个余弦要取 s 次幂。<bookmark mark='c'/>幂越大，波瓣越窄，高光越小越锐利，材质也就越有光泽。<bookmark mark='d'/>加上一个代表来自其他各处的光的环境常数，再加上漫反射项和高光，这就是我们光栅化器画出的球，幂取32。

0ce7a7ea7457.en: In 1977 Jim Blinn proposed a cheaper highlight. <bookmark mark='a'/> Instead of reflecting the light, take the vector halfway between the light and the eye, H, and measure how close the normal is to it. When the normal is exactly H, the eye sits in the mirror direction. <bookmark mark='b'/> The two highlights are not the same width with the same power. Near the peak, Phong's cosine to the power s behaves like a Gaussian in the angle alpha. <bookmark mark='c'/> The angle to H is about half of alpha, <bookmark mark='d'/> so Blinn's power must be four times larger to match. <bookmark mark='e'/> With a distant light and viewer, H is the same at every pixel, which made this the fixed-function lighting of OpenGL and Direct3D.
0ce7a7ea7457.zh: 1977年，Jim Blinn 提出了一种更便宜的高光。<bookmark mark='a'/>不去反射光，而是取光和眼睛正中间的那个向量，也就是半程向量 H，测量法线离它有多近。当法线恰好等于 H 时，眼睛就位于镜面方向上。<bookmark mark='b'/>同样的幂下，两种高光的宽度并不相同。在峰值附近，Phong 的余弦的 s 次幂，表现得像关于角 α 的一个高斯函数。<bookmark mark='c'/>到 H 的夹角大约是 α 的一半，<bookmark mark='d'/>所以 Blinn 的幂必须大4倍才能匹配。<bookmark mark='e'/>当光源和观察者都在远处时，H 在每个像素上都相同，这让它成了 OpenGL 和 Direct3D 的固定功能光照。

2174351dc224.en: Where should the lighting be computed? <bookmark mark='a'/> Henri Gouraud, in 1971, evaluated it once per vertex and let the rasterizer blend the colours, which is cheap. Phong's paper of 1975 also proposed the alternative: blend the normals, renormalize, and light every pixel. <bookmark mark='b'/> On a sphere of three hundred and sixty triangles the difference is in the highlight. <bookmark mark='c'/> Zoom in. Gouraud's highlight is a star of straight-edged blends, because a peak between vertices cannot be made by blending the values at the vertices. Phong's is round. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our rasterizer measures it: against the exact sphere, Gouraud's error is five times larger. Diffuse light varies slowly and survives vertex lighting; highlights do not, which is why every modern renderer lights per pixel.
2174351dc224.zh: 光照应该在哪里计算？<bookmark mark='a'/>1971年，Henri Gouraud 在每个顶点上算一次，再让光栅化器混合颜色，这很便宜。Phong 1975年的论文也提出了另一种做法：混合法线，重新归一化，再对每个像素计算光照。<bookmark mark='b'/>在一个由360个三角形组成的球上，差别出现在高光里。<bookmark mark='c'/>放大。Gouraud 的高光是一颗由直边混合构成的星，因为顶点之间的峰值，不可能靠混合顶点上的值得到。Phong 的则是圆的。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的光栅化器测量了它：与精确的球相比，Gouraud 的误差大5倍。漫反射光变化缓慢，经得起逐顶点光照；高光则不行，这就是每个现代渲染器都逐像素计算光照的原因。

a11f67d204f8.en: One last trap, back in chapter one's matrices. <bookmark mark='a'/> Normals are directions, so they are not translated. But squash a circle into an ellipse and move its normals with the same matrix, and they tilt: they are no longer perpendicular to the surface, and the lighting is wrong. <bookmark mark='b'/> Why? A normal is defined by being perpendicular to every tangent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Slip the identity, M inverse times M, between them. <bookmark mark='d'/> The tangents move by M, so to keep the product zero, normals must move by the inverse transpose. <bookmark mark='e'/> For rotations the two are the same matrix, which is why the mistake hides until an object is stretched, and why engines hand their shaders a separate normal matrix.
a11f67d204f8.zh: 最后一个陷阱，回到第一章的矩阵。<bookmark mark='a'/>法线是方向，所以它们不做平移。但把一个圆压扁成椭圆，并用同一个矩阵移动它的法线，它们就会倾斜：不再垂直于表面，光照也就错了。<bookmark mark='b'/>为什么？法线的定义，就是垂直于每一条切线。<bookmark mark='c'/>在它们之间塞进单位矩阵，也就是 M 的逆乘以 M。<bookmark mark='d'/>切线按 M 移动，所以要让乘积保持为零，法线必须按逆转置移动。<bookmark mark='e'/>对旋转来说，这两个是同一个矩阵，这就是为什么这个错误会一直藏着，直到某个物体被拉伸，也是为什么引擎要另外交给着色器一个法线矩阵。

4082fed10067.en: A texture is a picture glued onto a surface, Ed Catmull's idea of 1974. Looking it up is sampling, and sampling has a trap. <bookmark mark='a'/> A wave of nine cycles, sampled ten times. <bookmark mark='b'/> Join the samples and they trace a wave of one cycle, going the wrong way: an alias. <bookmark mark='c'/> A frequency f, sampled at a rate f s, is indistinguishable from f minus any multiple of f s. <bookmark mark='d'/> To be safe, take more than two samples per cycle, Nyquist's rule from Part 36. <bookmark mark='e'/> Our rasterizer looks up one texel at each pixel's centre. Near the horizon each pixel spans many squares, far beyond the Nyquist limit, and the samples draw curves that are not there: moiré.
4082fed10067.zh: 纹理是一幅粘到表面上的图片，这是 Ed Catmull 在1974年的想法。查找纹理就是采样，而采样有个陷阱。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个9个周期的波，采样10次。<bookmark mark='b'/>把样本连起来，它们描出的是一个只有1个周期、方向还反了的波：一个混叠。<bookmark mark='c'/>一个频率 f，以速率 f s 采样，与 f 减去 f s 的任意倍数无法区分。<bookmark mark='d'/>为了安全，每个周期要取两个以上的样本，这是第36部分的 Nyquist 准则。<bookmark mark='e'/>我们的光栅化器在每个像素中心查找一个纹素。靠近地平线时，每个像素横跨许多个方格，远远超出了 Nyquist 极限，样本画出了并不存在的曲线：摩尔纹。

441b74f7624a.en: Two cures: filter the texture before sampling, or take more samples. Here is the floor four ways, from our renderer. <bookmark mark='a'/> Point sampling: the moiré. <bookmark mark='b'/> The reference: two hundred and fifty-six jittered samples per pixel, averaged. <bookmark mark='c'/> Against it, point sampling is off by about a fifth of full brightness. <bookmark mark='d'/> A trilinear mipmap reads eight texels per pixel and cuts that error by a factor of three. <bookmark mark='e'/> Sixteen samples per pixel do slightly better, at twice the reads, and the far rows still shimmer. The cheap winner is the prefiltered texture.
441b74f7624a.zh: 两种解药：在采样之前对纹理做滤波，或者取更多的样本。这是用四种方式画出的地板，来自我们的渲染器。<bookmark mark='a'/>点采样：摩尔纹。<bookmark mark='b'/>参考图：每个像素256个抖动样本，取平均。<bookmark mark='c'/>与它相比，点采样的偏差大约是满亮度的五分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>三线性 mipmap 每个像素读取8个纹素，把这个误差降到三分之一。<bookmark mark='e'/>每个像素16个样本的效果稍好一点，但读取次数是两倍，而且远处的几行仍在闪烁。便宜的赢家是预先滤波的纹理。

0fcf54d8da6a.en: In 1983 Lance Williams proposed filtering the texture in advance, at every scale. <bookmark mark='a'/> Level zero is the texture. Each next level averages two by two blocks of the one before: half the width, half the height. <bookmark mark='b'/> By level five each texel covers a light and a dark square equally, and the pattern has become its average grey. Williams called it a mip map, from multum in parvo, many things in a small place. <bookmark mark='c'/> The cost? Each level has a quarter of the texels of the one before. <bookmark mark='d'/> The extra memory is a geometric series, <bookmark mark='e'/> one third. <bookmark mark='f'/> Our sixteen thousand texels become twenty-two thousand.
0fcf54d8da6a.zh: 1983年，Lance Williams 提出预先对纹理做滤波，而且在每一个尺度上都做。<bookmark mark='a'/>第0级就是纹理本身。下一级对上一级的每个2乘2块取平均：宽度减半，高度减半。<bookmark mark='b'/>到第5级，每个纹素均等地覆盖一个亮方格和一个暗方格，图案变成了它的平均灰色。Williams 把它叫作 mip map，取自拉丁语 multum in parvo，意思是小地方里的许多东西。<bookmark mark='c'/>代价呢？每一级的纹素是上一级的四分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>额外的内存是一个几何级数，<bookmark mark='e'/>三分之一。<bookmark mark='f'/>我们的1万6千个纹素变成了2万2千个。

9bb57d306dba.en: Which level should a pixel read? The one whose texels match the pixel's footprint. <bookmark mark='a'/> Step one pixel right, or one down, and measure how far the texture coordinates move, in texels; call the larger rho. <bookmark mark='b'/> If a step crosses four texels, then two levels down a texel is four times wider: the level is the logarithm, base two, of rho. <bookmark mark='c'/> Lambda is rarely whole, so trilinear filtering reads the two nearest levels, four texels each, and blends them: the eight reads. <bookmark mark='d'/> Here is the level our renderer chose at each pixel: zero near the camera, rising to seven, the single grey texel, at the horizon. <bookmark mark='e'/> On real hardware the derivatives come from neighbouring pixels, as the next chapter shows.
9bb57d306dba.zh: 一个像素该读哪一级？纹素与像素覆盖区域相匹配的那一级。<bookmark mark='a'/>向右走一个像素，或者向下走一个，测量纹理坐标移动了多远，以纹素为单位；把较大的那个叫作 ρ。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果一步跨过4个纹素，那么往下两级，一个纹素就宽4倍：级别就是 ρ 以2为底的对数。<bookmark mark='c'/>λ 很少是整数，所以三线性滤波读取最近的两级，各读4个纹素，再把它们混合：这就是那8次读取。<bookmark mark='d'/>这是我们的渲染器在每个像素上选的级别：靠近相机处为0，到地平线升到7，也就是那唯一一个灰色纹素。<bookmark mark='e'/>在真实硬件上，导数来自相邻的像素，下一章会讲到。

1d0e37481889.en: The mipmap has one flaw, and our floor shows it. <bookmark mark='a'/> At a grazing angle a square pixel lands on the texture as a long, thin footprint. <bookmark mark='b'/> Trilinear filtering uses one number, the larger derivative, so it filters a disc as wide as the long axis. <bookmark mark='c'/> Compare the top of our trilinear image with the reference: towards the horizon the squares have blurred into grey. <bookmark mark='d'/> Anisotropic filtering takes several probes along the long axis, each sized to the short axis, and averages them. <bookmark mark='e'/> The number of probes is the ratio of the axes, capped, and each probe reads a finer level.
1d0e37481889.zh: mipmap 有一个缺陷，我们的地板就暴露了它。<bookmark mark='a'/>在掠射角下，一个方形像素落在纹理上，是一块又长又窄的覆盖区域。<bookmark mark='b'/>三线性滤波只用一个数，也就是较大的那个导数，所以它滤波的是一个和长轴一样宽的圆盘。<bookmark mark='c'/>比较我们的三线性图像顶部和参考图：越往地平线，方格越模糊成一片灰色。<bookmark mark='d'/>各向异性滤波沿着长轴取若干个探针，每个按短轴定大小，再取平均。<bookmark mark='e'/>探针的个数是两轴之比，有上限，而每个探针读取更精细的一级。

3e37841e30c3.en: Mipmaps fix the inside of a triangle, but edges alias too, into staircases. <bookmark mark='a'/> The brute-force cure is supersampling: sixteen samples per pixel, each shaded, then averaged, for sixteen times the cost. <bookmark mark='b'/> Multisample antialiasing, MSAA, sees that a staircase is a coverage problem. It tests coverage and depth at four points per pixel, <bookmark mark='c'/> but runs the shader once per pixel per triangle and copies the colour to the covered samples. <bookmark mark='d'/> Averaging the samples softens the edge. <bookmark mark='e'/> Inside a triangle all four samples agree, so textures still need mipmaps. <bookmark mark='f'/> On our floor, sixteen samples beat the mipmap only slightly, for sixteen times the work. Good sampling is cheaper than more sampling.
3e37841e30c3.zh: mipmap 修好了三角形的内部，但边缘也会混叠，变成阶梯。<bookmark mark='a'/>蛮力的解药是超采样：每个像素16个样本，每个都着色，再取平均，代价是16倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>多重采样抗锯齿，MSAA，看出阶梯是一个覆盖问题。它在每个像素的4个点上测试覆盖和深度，<bookmark mark='c'/>但对每个像素、每个三角形只运行一次着色器，再把颜色复制到被覆盖的样本上。<bookmark mark='d'/>对样本取平均，边缘就变柔和了。<bookmark mark='e'/>在三角形内部，四个样本都一致，所以纹理仍然需要 mipmap。<bookmark mark='f'/>在我们的地板上，16个样本只比 mipmap 稍好一点，工作量却是16倍。好的采样，比更多的采样更便宜。

28344ee1e3e7.en: Everything so far is what a graphics processor does in hardware, organised as a pipeline. <bookmark mark='a'/> Vertices are fetched from memory and handed to a small program, the vertex shader, which applies the matrices of chapters one and two and outputs each vertex in clip coordinates. <bookmark mark='b'/> Fixed hardware clips, divides by w and maps to the screen, <bookmark mark='c'/> then rasterizes with chapter three's edge functions, producing fragments: candidate pixels carrying interpolated values. <bookmark mark='d'/> A second program, the fragment shader, computes each fragment's colour: chapters four and five. <bookmark mark='e'/> Finally the depth test and blending write the framebuffer. <bookmark mark='f'/> The green stages are programs you write; the orange ones are silicon. OpenGL, Direct3D, Vulkan, Metal and WebGPU all expose this same shape.
28344ee1e3e7.zh: 到目前为止的一切，都是图形处理器在硬件里做的事，组织成一条流水线。<bookmark mark='a'/>顶点从内存中取出，交给一个小程序，也就是顶点着色器，它施加第一章和第二章的矩阵，把每个顶点以裁剪坐标输出。<bookmark mark='b'/>固定功能的硬件做裁剪、除以 w，并映射到屏幕上，<bookmark mark='c'/>然后用第三章的边函数做光栅化，产生片元：携带着插值结果的候选像素。<bookmark mark='d'/>第二个程序，片元着色器，计算每个片元的颜色：这是第四章和第五章的内容。<bookmark mark='e'/>最后，深度测试和混合写入帧缓冲区。<bookmark mark='f'/>绿色的阶段是你写的程序；橙色的阶段是硅片。OpenGL、Direct3D、Vulkan、Metal 和 WebGPU 都暴露出同样的形状。

332262d26138.en: Here are the two programs, in the style of OpenGL's shading language. <bookmark mark='a'/> The vertex shader runs once per vertex. It multiplies the position by one combined model, view and projection matrix, and moves the normal by the normal matrix, chapter four's inverse transpose. <bookmark mark='b'/> Whatever it outputs, here the normal and the texture coordinates, the rasterizer interpolates across the triangle, perspective-correctly, with chapter three's one over w. <bookmark mark='c'/> The fragment shader runs once per fragment: renormalize the normal and take Lambert's cosine, <bookmark mark='d'/> then multiply by a texture lookup. That one call is chapter five's trilinear filter, in dedicated hardware. <bookmark mark='e'/> Neither program can see any other vertex or fragment, and that independence is what lets a GPU run millions of them at once.
332262d26138.zh: 这是那两个程序，写成 OpenGL 着色语言的风格。<bookmark mark='a'/>顶点着色器对每个顶点运行一次。它把位置乘以一个合并了模型、视图和投影的矩阵，再用法线矩阵，也就是第四章的逆转置，来移动法线。<bookmark mark='b'/>无论它输出什么，这里是法线和纹理坐标，光栅化器都会在三角形上做插值，而且是透视校正的，用的是第三章的1除以 w。<bookmark mark='c'/>片元着色器对每个片元运行一次：把法线重新归一化，取 Lambert 的余弦，<bookmark mark='d'/>再乘以一次纹理查找。这一个调用，就是第五章的三线性滤波，在专用硬件里完成。<bookmark mark='e'/>两个程序都看不到任何别的顶点或片元，正是这种独立性，让 GPU 能同时运行数以百万计的它们。

0172702538ee.en: How many runs is that? A screen of nineteen twenty by ten eighty has about two million pixels, and each needs its own fragment shader run, sixty times a second. <bookmark mark='a'/> Because every run is independent, the GPU packs fragments, in blocks of two by two called quads, <bookmark mark='b'/> into groups that share one instruction stream: on NVIDIA hardware a warp of thirty-two lanes, the SIMT model of Part 10 and of AI, Built part seventeen. <bookmark mark='c'/> The price is branching. If some fragments of a warp take one side of an if and the rest take the other, <bookmark mark='d'/> the warp runs both sides, one after the other, with part of its lanes switched off each time. A shader that branches pixel by pixel can run at half speed, or worse.
0172702538ee.zh: 那是多少次运行？一块1920乘1080的屏幕大约有200万个像素，每个都需要自己的一次片元着色器运行，每秒60次。<bookmark mark='a'/>因为每次运行都是独立的，GPU 把片元按2乘2的块打包，这种块叫作 quad，<bookmark mark='b'/>再编进共享一条指令流的组里：在 NVIDIA 的硬件上，就是一个有32条通道的线程束，也就是第10部分和《人工智能，从零搭建》第17部分的单指令多线程模型。<bookmark mark='c'/>代价是分支。如果一个线程束里有些片元走 if 的一边，其余的走另一边，<bookmark mark='d'/>这个线程束就两边都要执行，一边接一边，每次都关掉一部分通道。一个逐像素分支的着色器，可能只以一半的速度运行，甚至更糟。

561178f23d93.en: Quads are how a GPU gets derivatives. <bookmark mark='a'/> Within a two by two block, the value at the right-hand pixel minus the value at the left is the derivative across the screen, and the same vertically. That is chapter five's rho, and so the mip level, by one subtraction. <bookmark mark='b'/> But along a triangle's edge, a quad may cover only one, two or three pixels. The rest still run, as helper lanes, only to supply the differences, and their colours are thrown away. <bookmark mark='c'/> For chapter three's triangle, our rasterizer's coverage touches one thousand two hundred and thirty-six quads: one hundred and ninety-six helper lanes, four per cent extra. <bookmark mark='d'/> A triangle covering a single pixel wastes three lanes of four, which is why very small triangles are expensive on GPUs.
561178f23d93.zh: quad 是 GPU 获得导数的方式。<bookmark mark='a'/>在一个2乘2的块里，右边像素的值减去左边像素的值，就是沿屏幕横向的导数，纵向也一样。这就是第五章的 ρ，因此也就得到了 mip 级别，只要一次减法。<bookmark mark='b'/>但沿着三角形的边，一个 quad 可能只覆盖一个、两个或三个像素。其余的照样运行，作为辅助通道，只是为了提供差值，它们的颜色会被丢掉。<bookmark mark='c'/>对第三章的那个三角形，我们的光栅化器的覆盖触及1236个 quad：196条辅助通道，多出百分之4。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个只覆盖单个像素的三角形，四条通道里浪费三条，这就是为什么非常小的三角形在 GPU 上很昂贵。

ee695db67ce1.en: Last, where the depth test sits. <bookmark mark='a'/> Chapter three's two crossing triangles produce six thousand five hundred and seventy-six fragments. If every fragment is shaded first and depth-tested afterwards, every one of them pays for a fragment shader. <bookmark mark='b'/> GPUs test depth before shading whenever the shader cannot change the outcome. In our run, six hundred and ninety-three fragments fail the test, and are never shaded. <bookmark mark='c'/> But only five thousand four hundred and twelve pixels are visible: four hundred and seventy-one fragments passed, were shaded, and were painted over by a nearer one drawn later. <bookmark mark='d'/> So engines draw opaque objects front to back, or lay down depth in a first pass, and then shade each visible pixel exactly once.
ee695db67ce1.zh: 最后，深度测试放在哪里。<bookmark mark='a'/>第三章那两个交叉的三角形产生6576个片元。如果每个片元都先着色、再做深度测试，那它们每一个都要为片元着色器付出代价。<bookmark mark='b'/>只要着色器不能改变结果，GPU 就在着色之前测试深度。在我们这次运行中，693个片元没有通过测试，从未被着色。<bookmark mark='c'/>但只有5412个像素是可见的：有471个片元通过了测试、被着色，然后又被后来画的一个更近的片元盖住。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以引擎从前到后绘制不透明物体，或者先用一遍只写下深度，然后让每个可见像素恰好着色一次。

81e8c492752c.en: Rasterization starts from the triangles; ray tracing starts from the eye. <bookmark mark='a'/> For every pixel, shoot a ray through the pixel's centre: a point o plus t times a direction d. <bookmark mark='b'/> Intersect it with every object and keep the nearest hit with t positive: that is what the pixel sees. Arthur Appel did this in 1968, for hidden surfaces and shadows. <bookmark mark='c'/> It is the z-buffer turned around: instead of each triangle asking which pixels it covers, each pixel asks which object it meets first. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our tracer sends nineteen thousand two hundred such rays for a small image, then, following Turner Whitted, keeps going.
81e8c492752c.zh: 光栅化从三角形出发；光线追踪从眼睛出发。<bookmark mark='a'/>对每个像素，穿过像素中心射出一条光线：一个点 o 加上 t 乘以方向 d。<bookmark mark='b'/>求它与每个物体的交点，保留 t 为正的最近交点：这就是这个像素看到的东西。Arthur Appel 在1968年这样做过，用来处理隐藏面和阴影。<bookmark mark='c'/>它就是倒过来的 z 缓冲区：不是每个三角形问自己覆盖哪些像素，而是每个像素问自己最先遇到哪个物体。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的追踪器为一幅小图射出19200条这样的光线，然后，沿着 Turner Whitted 的做法，继续往前走。

a83d50f39f5b.en: The simplest object is a sphere. <bookmark mark='a'/> A point on the ray is on the sphere when its distance from the centre is the radius. <bookmark mark='b'/> Expand the squared length as a dot product, and it is a quadratic in t. <bookmark mark='c'/> Name the coefficients A, B and C, <bookmark mark='d'/> and the roots follow. The discriminant decides everything. <bookmark mark='e'/> Slide the ray: positive, two hits, in and out; zero, the ray grazes the sphere; negative, it misses. The smaller positive root is the hit we see. <bookmark mark='f'/> And from Part 4: the textbook formula can subtract nearly equal numbers, so our code computes one root safely and the other from their product.
a83d50f39f5b.zh: 最简单的物体是球。<bookmark mark='a'/>光线上的一个点，当它到球心的距离等于半径时，就在球面上。<bookmark mark='b'/>把长度的平方展开成点积，它就是一个关于 t 的二次方程。<bookmark mark='c'/>把系数叫作 A、B 和 C，<bookmark mark='d'/>根就随之而来。判别式决定一切。<bookmark mark='e'/>滑动这条光线：为正，两个交点，一进一出；为零，光线擦过球面；为负，它没有击中。较小的那个正根就是我们看到的交点。<bookmark mark='f'/>还有第4部分的教训：教科书公式可能会让两个几乎相等的数相减，所以我们的代码安全地算出一个根，再从两根之积求出另一个。

b5916613734e.en: Most scenes are triangles. In 1997 Tomas Möller and Ben Trumbore published the test most ray tracers still use. <bookmark mark='a'/> A point of the triangle is a blend of its corners with barycentric weights, chapter three's again; the ray hits it when the two points agree. <bookmark mark='b'/> Measure everything from the first corner, along the two edges. <bookmark mark='c'/> That is a three by three linear system for t, u and v. <bookmark mark='d'/> Solve it by Cramer's rule: each determinant is a triple product, and they share two cross products, p and q. <bookmark mark='e'/> It is a hit when u and v are non-negative, sum to at most one, and t is positive; and u and v come out free, ready for texturing.
b5916613734e.zh: 大多数场景由三角形组成。1997年，Tomas Möller 和 Ben Trumbore 发表了至今大多数光线追踪器仍在使用的测试。<bookmark mark='a'/>三角形上的一点，是它的角按重心权重的混合，又是第三章的那一套；当这两个点重合时，光线就击中了它。<bookmark mark='b'/>一切都从第一个角量起，沿着两条边。<bookmark mark='c'/>这是一个关于 t、u 和 v 的三乘三线性方程组。<bookmark mark='d'/>用克莱姆法则求解：每个行列式都是一个三重积，而它们共用两个叉积，p 和 q。<bookmark mark='e'/>当 u 和 v 非负、它们的和至多为1、并且 t 为正时，就是一次击中；而且 u 和 v 免费得到，随时可以用来贴纹理。

a9b38d242a0d.en: Turner Whitted's paper of 1980 asked what happens after the first hit. <bookmark mark='a'/> At a matte surface, cast a shadow ray towards the light; if something is in the way, the point is in shadow. <bookmark mark='b'/> At a mirror, trace the reflected ray by the same procedure. Here it finds the red ball, at a point the mirror itself hides from the light. <bookmark mark='c'/> At glass, trace two: a reflected ray, and a refracted one that bends into the ball and out again. Each pixel grows a tree. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our tracer counts them: nineteen thousand two hundred primary rays, thirteen and a half thousand shadow rays, over four thousand each reflected and refracted: about two per pixel.
a9b38d242a0d.zh: Turner Whitted 1980年的论文追问了第一次击中之后会发生什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>在哑光表面上，朝光源投出一条阴影光线；如果有东西挡在中间，这个点就在阴影里。<bookmark mark='b'/>在镜子上，用同样的过程追踪反射光线。这里它找到了红球，落在一个被镜子本身挡住了光源的点上。<bookmark mark='c'/>在玻璃上，追踪两条：一条反射光线，以及一条弯折进球里、再穿出来的折射光线。每个像素长出一棵树。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的追踪器数了数：19200条主光线，1万3千5百条阴影光线，反射和折射光线各4千多条：大约每个像素两条。

455a53cbace4.en: Glass bends light. <bookmark mark='a'/> Snell's law: the index of refraction times the sine of the angle is the same on both sides. <bookmark mark='b'/> A ray tracer wants it in vectors: the bent direction is a blend of the incoming direction and the normal, no angles needed. <bookmark mark='c'/> Going from glass into air, the square root can fail. <bookmark mark='d'/> Tilt the ray inside the glass: beyond about forty-two degrees there is no refracted ray, and all the light reflects. <bookmark mark='e'/> In a ball this never happens: the radii to entry and exit make an isosceles triangle, so a ray leaves at the angle it entered. Our tracer counted zero.
455a53cbace4.zh: 玻璃会让光弯折。<bookmark mark='a'/>Snell 定律：折射率乘以角的正弦，在两侧相同。<bookmark mark='b'/>光线追踪器想要它的向量形式：弯折后的方向是入射方向和法线的混合，不需要任何角度。<bookmark mark='c'/>从玻璃进入空气时，平方根可能失败。<bookmark mark='d'/>在玻璃内部倾斜光线：超过大约42度时，就没有折射光线了，所有的光都被反射。<bookmark mark='e'/>在一个球里，这永远不会发生：到入射点和出射点的两条半径构成一个等腰三角形，所以光线以它进入时的角度离开。我们的追踪器数到的是零。

3314540ca0c0.en: How much light reflects, and how much goes through? <bookmark mark='a'/> Fresnel's equations answer exactly: head on, glass reflects four per cent, climbing to all of it at grazing angles. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 1994 Christophe Schlick fitted this with one fifth power, <bookmark mark='c'/> anchored at the head-on value, four hundredths for glass. <bookmark mark='d'/> Our tracer gives each glass hit a reflected ray weighted by R and a refracted ray weighted by one minus R, and drops branches whose weight is negligible. So the rim of our glass ball mirrors the floor and the sky, while its middle shows the scene behind it, bent by refraction.
3314540ca0c0.zh: 有多少光被反射，又有多少穿过去？<bookmark mark='a'/>Fresnel 方程给出了精确的答案：正对着时，玻璃反射百分之4，到掠射角时上升到全部。<bookmark mark='b'/>1994年，Christophe Schlick 用一个五次幂拟合了它，<bookmark mark='c'/>锚定在正对时的值上，对玻璃是0.04。<bookmark mark='d'/>我们的追踪器给玻璃上的每次击中一条按 R 加权的反射光线，和一条按1减 R 加权的折射光线，并丢掉权重可以忽略的分支。所以我们的玻璃球的边缘映出了地板和天空，而它的中间显示出背后的场景，被折射弯折了。

09341a567beb.en: A ray tracer spends nearly all its time on one question: which triangle does this ray hit first? <bookmark mark='a'/> The obvious answer tests every triangle and keeps the nearest. <bookmark mark='b'/> Forty triangles, forty tests, for one hit. <bookmark mark='c'/> Our Whitted image used forty-one and a half thousand rays. Against a mesh of a hundred thousand triangles, the largest we test below, that is over four billion intersection tests for a tiny picture. <bookmark mark='d'/> And almost all of them are wasted: each ray keeps one answer. <bookmark mark='e'/> The cure, from Steven Rubin and Turner Whitted in 1980, is the same as for a library: put things in boxes, and boxes in bigger boxes. A ray that misses a box can skip everything inside it.
09341a567beb.zh: 光线追踪器几乎把全部时间都花在一个问题上：这条光线最先击中哪个三角形？<bookmark mark='a'/>显而易见的答案是测试每一个三角形，保留最近的那个。<bookmark mark='b'/>40个三角形，40次测试，换来一次击中。<bookmark mark='c'/>我们那幅 Whitted 图用了4万1千5百条光线。面对一个有10万个三角形的网格，也就是我们下面测试的最大的那个，一幅小小的图就要超过40亿次求交测试。<bookmark mark='d'/>而其中几乎全部都是浪费：每条光线只保留一个答案。<bookmark mark='e'/>解药来自1980年的 Steven Rubin 和 Turner Whitted，和图书馆的做法一样：把东西装进盒子，再把盒子装进更大的盒子。一条没有击中某个盒子的光线，可以跳过盒子里的一切。

ab6ca0e876c4.en: Here is the idea built on our forty triangles. <bookmark mark='a'/> Put one box around everything: the root. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sort the triangles along the box's wider side and split them at the median, boxing each half. <bookmark mark='c'/> Repeat inside each half, <bookmark mark='d'/> and again, until a box holds at most three triangles. Each box is a node of a binary tree, the leaves hold the triangles. <bookmark mark='e'/> The boxes of two children may overlap. A bounding volume hierarchy divides the objects, not space, so every triangle lives in exactly one leaf, and a box can be refitted cheaply when its triangles move. <bookmark mark='f'/> Halving at every level, the depth grows like the logarithm of the number of triangles.
ab6ca0e876c4.zh: 这是在我们那40个三角形上搭起来的这个想法。<bookmark mark='a'/>在所有东西外面套一个盒子：根。<bookmark mark='b'/>沿盒子较宽的一边给三角形排序，在中位数处把它们分开，给每一半各套一个盒子。<bookmark mark='c'/>在每一半里重复，<bookmark mark='d'/>再重复，直到一个盒子至多装三个三角形。每个盒子是一棵二叉树的一个节点，叶子装着三角形。<bookmark mark='e'/>两个孩子的盒子可能重叠。包围体层次结构划分的是物体，而不是空间，所以每个三角形恰好住在一个叶子里，而当盒子里的三角形移动时，盒子可以便宜地重新拟合。<bookmark mark='f'/>每一层都减半，深度就像三角形数目的对数那样增长。

32b91d581ddd.en: Now trace a ray through the tree. <bookmark mark='a'/> Testing a box is cheap: Kay and Kajiya's slab test. For each axis, find where the ray enters and leaves the slab between the box's two planes. <bookmark mark='b'/> The ray is inside the box between the latest entry and the earliest exit, so it hits the box when that interval is not empty. <bookmark mark='c'/> Start at the root. At each box it enters, visit the nearer child first; skip a box it misses, or one that begins beyond the best hit found so far. <bookmark mark='d'/> In the leaves it reaches, test the triangles. <bookmark mark='e'/> This ray needed a handful of boxes and a few triangles instead of all forty, and found the same nearest hit.
32b91d581ddd.zh: 现在让一条光线穿过这棵树。<bookmark mark='a'/>测试一个盒子很便宜：这是 Kay 和 Kajiya 的平板测试。对每根轴，找出光线进入和离开盒子两个平面之间那块平板的位置。<bookmark mark='b'/>光线在最晚的进入和最早的离开之间位于盒子内部，所以当这个区间非空时，它就击中了盒子。<bookmark mark='c'/>从根开始。在它进入的每个盒子处，先访问较近的孩子；跳过它没有击中的盒子，或者起点比目前找到的最佳交点还远的盒子。<bookmark mark='d'/>在它到达的叶子里，测试三角形。<bookmark mark='e'/>这条光线只需要几个盒子和几个三角形，而不是全部40个，并且找到了同一个最近的交点。

7edd80468e06.en: The median split ignores where the triangles are. Here, nine are bunched at the left and three spread to the right. Where should the box be cut? <bookmark mark='a'/> Price a split by its expected cost: one box test, plus each child's triangles, weighted by the chance that a ray entering the parent enters that child. <bookmark mark='b'/> For random rays that chance is the child's surface area over the parent's, a classical result of integral geometry. <bookmark mark='c'/> With both unit costs one, as in our builder, this is the surface area heuristic of MacDonald and Booth, 1990. <bookmark mark='d'/> Sweep a candidate plane across, as Part 22 swept lines, and evaluate the cost at each position. <bookmark mark='e'/> The median cuts through the cluster and leaves a wide box of six. The cheapest plane puts the whole cluster in one compact box, the three stragglers in another. <bookmark mark='f'/> And if no split beats testing every triangle, make a leaf.
7edd80468e06.zh: 中位数划分不管三角形在哪里。这里，有9个挤在左边，3个散在右边。盒子该在哪里切开？<bookmark mark='a'/>按一次划分的期望代价给它定价：一次盒子测试，加上每个孩子的三角形，按一条进入父盒子的光线也进入那个孩子的概率加权。<bookmark mark='b'/>对随机光线，这个概率是孩子的表面积除以父盒子的表面积，这是积分几何的一个经典结果。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个单位代价都取1，就像我们的构建器那样，这就是 MacDonald 和 Booth 在1990年提出的表面积启发式。<bookmark mark='d'/>让一个候选平面扫过去，就像第22部分扫过直线那样，在每个位置上计算代价。<bookmark mark='e'/>中位数切穿了那一簇，留下一个装着6个三角形的宽盒子。最便宜的平面把整簇放进一个紧凑的盒子，把三个掉队的放进另一个。<bookmark mark='f'/>而如果没有哪种划分比测试每个三角形更好，就做成一个叶子。

e6515153a0e5.en: Now our real BVH, in three dimensions, built over random terrain meshes from a hundred to a hundred thousand triangles, and traced with a grid of camera rays. <bookmark mark='a'/> Brute force tests every triangle, a straight line on this logarithmic plot. <bookmark mark='b'/> With the median split, between about seven and ten triangle tests per ray, whatever the size. <bookmark mark='c'/> With the surface area heuristic, between two and three. <bookmark mark='d'/> The work moves into the boxes. Plotted against the logarithm of the number of triangles, the boxes visited per ray rise in a nearly straight line: every tenfold increase adds about nine. That is the logarithm per ray. <bookmark mark='e'/> At a hundred thousand triangles, each ray does two and a half triangle tests and visits thirty-nine boxes, instead of a hundred thousand tests, and on every ray we checked it finds the same nearest hit as brute force.
e6515153a0e5.zh: 现在是我们真正的 BVH，在三维空间里，建在从100到10万个三角形的随机地形网格上，并用排成网格的相机光线来追踪。<bookmark mark='a'/>蛮力法测试每一个三角形，在这张对数图上是一条直线。<bookmark mark='b'/>用中位数划分，每条光线大约7到10次三角形测试，不论规模多大。<bookmark mark='c'/>用表面积启发式，2到3次。<bookmark mark='d'/>工作转移到了盒子上。以三角形数目的对数为横轴，每条光线访问的盒子数沿一条几乎笔直的线上升：规模每增加10倍，大约多9个。这就是每条光线一个对数。<bookmark mark='e'/>在10万个三角形时，每条光线做2.5次三角形测试，访问39个盒子，而不是10万次测试；而且在我们检查过的每一条光线上，它都和蛮力法找到同一个最近的交点。

d46fc2f6bfd2.zh: 第九章：辐射度量学与 BRDF。

2ef2cfb8a397.en: First, directions. <bookmark mark='a'/> An angle in the plane is an arc length divided by the radius, in radians. <bookmark mark='b'/> A solid angle is the same idea one dimension up: the area a shape covers on a sphere, divided by the radius squared, in steradians. <bookmark mark='c'/> On the unit sphere a small patch of latitude and longitude has area sine theta d theta d phi. <bookmark mark='d'/> Integrate it over a cap of half-angle alpha: two pi times one minus cos alpha. <bookmark mark='e'/> Open the cap to ninety degrees and it covers every direction above a surface: two pi steradians, half the sphere's four pi.
2ef2cfb8a397.zh: 首先，方向。<bookmark mark='a'/>平面上的一个角，是弧长除以半径，单位是弧度。<bookmark mark='b'/>立体角是同一个想法升高一维：一个形状在球面上覆盖的面积，除以半径的平方，单位是球面度。<bookmark mark='c'/>在单位球面上，一小块经纬网格的面积是 sin θ dθ dφ。<bookmark mark='d'/>在半角为 α 的球冠上积分：2π 乘以1减 cos α。<bookmark mark='e'/>把球冠张开到90度，它就覆盖了表面上方的每一个方向：2π 球面度，是整个球面4π 的一半。

0f5a3e057fc4.en: Now the quantities. <bookmark mark='a'/> Radiant flux, capital phi, is energy per second, in watts. <bookmark mark='b'/> Irradiance is flux arriving per unit area: how brightly a surface is lit. <bookmark mark='c'/> Radiance divides once more: flux per unit area across the beam, per unit solid angle. The cosine is there because a patch seen at a slant presents only cos theta of its area. <bookmark mark='d'/> Radiance is what a camera pixel measures: a small area looking along a narrow cone. <bookmark mark='e'/> Gathered over the hemisphere with the cosine, radiance gives back irradiance: Lambert's law of chapter four.
0f5a3e057fc4.zh: 现在是各个量。<bookmark mark='a'/>辐射通量，大写的 Φ，是每秒的能量，单位是瓦特。<bookmark mark='b'/>辐照度是单位面积上到达的通量：一个表面被照得有多亮。<bookmark mark='c'/>辐亮度再除一次：垂直于光束的单位面积、单位立体角上的通量。余弦之所以在那里，是因为一块斜着看的面片，只呈现出它面积的 cos θ 倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>辐亮度就是相机像素测量的东西：一小块面积，沿着一个窄锥看出去。<bookmark mark='e'/>把辐亮度带着余弦在半球上汇总起来，就得回辐照度：这就是第四章的 Lambert 定律。

bd099f712515.en: Radiance has one property that makes ray tracing possible. <bookmark mark='a'/> A pixel looks along a narrow cone. Move the wall away, and the patch of wall inside the cone grows with the square of the distance, <bookmark mark='b'/> while the share of each bit's light that enters the pixel falls with the inverse square. <bookmark mark='c'/> They cancel: in empty space, radiance is constant along a ray. That is why a wall does not darken as you walk away from it. <bookmark mark='d'/> And it is why a ray tracer can carry one number, the radiance, from the surface it hits straight back to the eye.
bd099f712515.zh: 辐亮度有一个性质，让光线追踪成为可能。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个像素沿着一个窄锥看出去。把墙移远，锥里那一块墙随距离的平方增大，<bookmark mark='b'/>而每一小块的光进入像素的份额，按距离平方的倒数减小。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者抵消：在空的空间里，辐亮度沿着光线不变。这就是为什么你从一面墙走开时，它不会变暗。<bookmark mark='d'/>这也是为什么光线追踪器可以携带一个数，也就是辐亮度，从它击中的表面直接带回眼睛。

d8765c0af8aa.en: How a material reflects is a function of two directions. <bookmark mark='a'/> The BRDF, the bidirectional reflectance distribution function named by Fred Nicodemus and colleagues in 1977, is the radiance going out in one direction per unit of irradiance arriving from another. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add up every incoming direction, and we have the reflection equation. <bookmark mark='c'/> A matte surface scatters equally everywhere, so its BRDF is a constant, rho over pi. <bookmark mark='d'/> Why pi? The cosine integrated over the hemisphere is two pi times one half: pi. <bookmark mark='e'/> So under uniform light of radiance one, a matte surface returns exactly its albedo. <bookmark mark='f'/> A glossy surface instead gathers its light into a lobe around the mirror direction.
d8765c0af8aa.zh: 一种材料怎样反射，是两个方向的函数。<bookmark mark='a'/>BRDF，也就是双向反射分布函数，由 Fred Nicodemus 等人在1977年命名，它是沿一个方向射出的辐亮度，除以从另一个方向到达的辐照度。<bookmark mark='b'/>把每一个入射方向加起来，我们就得到了反射方程。<bookmark mark='c'/>哑光表面向各处均匀散射，所以它的 BRDF 是一个常数，ρ 除以 π。<bookmark mark='d'/>为什么是 π？余弦在半球上的积分是2π 乘以二分之一：π。<bookmark mark='e'/>所以在辐亮度为1的均匀光照下，哑光表面恰好返回它的反照率。<bookmark mark='f'/>而有光泽的表面，则把它的光聚拢成镜面方向周围的一个波瓣。

64d9b610f8a8.en: Glossy surfaces are rough at a scale far below a pixel. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 1982 Robert Cook and Kenneth Torrance modelled them as tiny mirrors, microfacets, tilted at random. <bookmark mark='b'/> A facet sends light from one direction to the other only if its normal is the half vector between them. <bookmark mark='c'/> So the BRDF is D, the density of facets facing the half vector; times G, the fraction not hidden or shadowed by their neighbours; times F, the Fresnel reflectance of chapter seven; over four cosines from the change of variables. <bookmark mark='d'/> The GGX distribution, brought to graphics by Bruce Walter and colleagues in 2007, has one parameter, the roughness alpha. <bookmark mark='e'/> Turn it up and the facets spread: the highlight widens and dims.
64d9b610f8a8.zh: 有光泽的表面，在远小于一个像素的尺度上是粗糙的。<bookmark mark='a'/>1982年，Robert Cook 和 Kenneth Torrance 把它们建模为随机倾斜的微小镜面，也就是微表面。<bookmark mark='b'/>一个小面只有当它的法线是两个方向之间的半程向量时，才会把光从一个方向送到另一个方向。<bookmark mark='c'/>所以 BRDF 是 D，朝向半程向量的小面的密度；乘以 G，没有被邻居遮挡或遮蔽的比例；乘以 F，第七章的 Fresnel 反射率；再除以变量替换带来的4乘两个余弦。<bookmark mark='d'/>GGX 分布由 Bruce Walter 等人在2007年引入图形学，它只有一个参数，粗糙度 α。<bookmark mark='e'/>把它调大，小面就散开：高光变宽、变暗。

8d9a05876429.en: Every physical BRDF obeys two rules, and our instruments check both. <bookmark mark='a'/> Reciprocity: swapping the two directions gives the same value. On ten thousand random pairs our four models agree to rounding. <bookmark mark='b'/> Energy conservation: lit equally from every direction, in a white furnace, a surface must return at most one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Lambert returns exactly one. Normalized Phong returns one head-on, and less at grazing angles, where its lobe dips below the horizon. <bookmark mark='d'/> The usual Blinn-Phong normalization is only approximate: at exponent ten it creates energy, one point nought seven five. <bookmark mark='e'/> GGX keeps nearly everything when smooth, but at roughness one it loses more than two thirds head-on, because the model leaves out light that bounces between facets more than once.
8d9a05876429.zh: 每一个符合物理的 BRDF 都遵守两条规则，我们的仪器两条都检查。<bookmark mark='a'/>互易性：交换两个方向，值不变。在1万对随机方向上，我们的四个模型在舍入误差内一致。<bookmark mark='b'/>能量守恒：在一个白炉里，也就是从每个方向均匀照亮时，一个表面返回的至多是1。<bookmark mark='c'/>Lambert 恰好返回1。归一化的 Phong 在正对时返回1，在掠射角下返回得更少，因为那里它的波瓣沉到了地平线以下。<bookmark mark='d'/>通常的 Blinn-Phong 归一化只是近似的：在指数为10时，它凭空产生了能量，1.075。<bookmark mark='e'/>GGX 在光滑时几乎保住了一切，但在粗糙度为1时，正对着会损失三分之二以上，因为这个模型漏掉了在小面之间反弹不止一次的光。

a79b82387739.en: Chapter nine's reflection equation needs the light arriving at a point. <bookmark mark='a'/> Take a point on the back wall. Light arrives from every direction in front of it. <bookmark mark='b'/> But each arrival is light leaving some other surface: the ceiling, the lamp, the two balls, or nothing at all through the open front. <bookmark mark='c'/> And what leaves that surface depends in turn on everything arriving there. <bookmark mark='d'/> Write it down. The light leaving a point is what it emits, plus what it reflects. <bookmark mark='e'/> The light arriving from a direction is the light leaving the first surface a ray meets that way, the job of chapters seven and eight. <bookmark mark='f'/> Substitute, and the unknown radiance appears on both sides. This is the rendering equation, published by James Kajiya in 1986: a balance of energy at every point and in every direction.
a79b82387739.zh: 第九章的反射方程，需要知道到达一个点的光。<bookmark mark='a'/>在后墙上取一个点。光从它前方的每个方向到达。<bookmark mark='b'/>但每一份到达的光，都是离开另外某个表面的光：天花板、灯、两个球，或者穿过敞开的正面，什么都没有。<bookmark mark='c'/>而离开那个表面的东西，又取决于到达那里的一切。<bookmark mark='d'/>把它写下来。离开一个点的光，是它发出的光，加上它反射的光。<bookmark mark='e'/>从一个方向到达的光，就是离开光线沿那个方向遇到的第一个表面的光，这是第七章和第八章的工作。<bookmark mark='f'/>代入，未知的辐亮度就出现在两边。这就是渲染方程，由 James Kajiya 在1986年发表：在每一个点、每一个方向上的能量平衡。

2c4e378b32c4.en: Name the integral as an operator. <bookmark mark='a'/> T takes a field of radiance and returns the light reflected once: cast a ray, look up the radiance there, weight it by the BRDF and the cosine, and integrate. The equation becomes L equals L e plus T L. <bookmark mark='b'/> Move T L across, and invert. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then expand as a geometric series, exactly as one over one minus x is one plus x plus x squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> This Neumann series converges when T shrinks every field, and chapter nine's furnace guarantees it: each reflection keeps at most its albedo. <bookmark mark='e'/> In a closed room with walls of albedo nought point seven three, our white walls, each bounce keeps seventy-three per cent, and the bounces add up to three point seven times the light emitted.
2c4e378b32c4.zh: 把这个积分命名为一个算子。<bookmark mark='a'/>T 接受一个辐亮度场，返回反射一次的光：投出一条光线，查出那里的辐亮度，用 BRDF 和余弦加权，再积分。方程变成了 L 等于 L e 加 T L。<bookmark mark='b'/>把 T L 移到另一边，然后求逆。<bookmark mark='c'/>再展开成几何级数，正如1除以1减 x 等于1加 x 加 x 的平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>当 T 让每个场都缩小时，这个 Neumann 级数收敛，而第九章的白炉保证了这一点：每次反射至多保留它的反照率。<bookmark mark='e'/>在一个墙壁反照率为0.73的封闭房间里，也就是我们的白墙，每次反弹保留百分之73，所有反弹加起来是发出的光的3.7倍。

aab73e462175.en: Each term of the series has a picture. <bookmark mark='a'/> L e alone is light that goes from the lamp straight into the eye. <bookmark mark='b'/> T L e is light that reflected once on its way to us: off the floor, or off the mirror ball. This is direct lighting. <bookmark mark='c'/> T squared L e is light that bounced twice, from the back wall onto the floor and then to the eye. <bookmark mark='d'/> Each term is an integral over every path with that many reflections, and the picture is the sum over all lengths. Eric Veach's thesis of 1997 wrote the whole equation as a single integral over paths, which is the form the next chapter samples.
aab73e462175.zh: 级数的每一项都有一幅图。<bookmark mark='a'/>单独的 L e，是从灯直接进入眼睛的光。<bookmark mark='b'/>T L e 是在到达我们之前反射了一次的光：从地板上，或者从镜面球上。这就是直接光照。<bookmark mark='c'/>T 的平方乘 L e，是反弹了两次的光，从后墙到地板，再到眼睛。<bookmark mark='d'/>每一项都是对具有那么多次反射的所有路径的积分，而图像是对所有长度求和。Eric Veach 1997年的博士论文，把整个方程写成了对路径的单个积分，下一章采样的正是这种形式。

7ca6f5901df8.en: Our path tracer records each path's light by the number of reflections it took, so we can watch the series add up, term by term, in our own scene. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bounce zero: only the lamp. <bookmark mark='b'/> Add bounce one, direct lighting. The floor and walls are lit, the balls cast shadows, and the mirror shows the walls; but the ceiling is black, because no light reaches it directly. <bookmark mark='c'/> Add bounce two. The ceiling appears, the shadows soften, and red and green light spills onto the white surfaces. <bookmark mark='d'/> Three, four, five and beyond: each adds less, and the picture settles into the converged image. <bookmark mark='e'/> Nothing here was painted on. Soft shadows and colour bleeding are simply the later terms of the series.
7ca6f5901df8.zh: 我们的路径追踪器按每条路径经历的反射次数记录它的光，所以我们能在自己的场景里，看着这个级数一项一项地加起来。<bookmark mark='a'/>第0次反弹：只有灯。<bookmark mark='b'/>加上第1次反弹，也就是直接光照。地板和墙被照亮，球投下阴影，镜子映出墙；但天花板是黑的，因为没有光直接到达它。<bookmark mark='c'/>加上第2次反弹。天花板出现了，阴影变柔和，红光和绿光洒到白色的表面上。<bookmark mark='d'/>第3、4、5次以及更多：每一次加得更少，图像逐渐稳定成收敛的图像。<bookmark mark='e'/>这里没有任何东西是画上去的。柔和的阴影和颜色渗透，不过是级数里靠后的那些项。

b43237bee326.en: How fast do the terms shrink? <bookmark mark='a'/> On a logarithmic scale the mean brightness of each bounce image falls on a nearly straight line. <bookmark mark='b'/> From the first bounce on, each term is between nought point three eight and nought point five three times the one before: a geometric series, as the operator view predicted. The light lost at each bounce is absorbed by the coloured walls, or escapes through the open front. <bookmark mark='c'/> The eight images add up exactly to the converged image. <bookmark mark='d'/> And the later terms matter: of the light that reaches the eye from surfaces, forty-three per cent took two or more bounces. A renderer that stops at direct light loses all of it; the radiosity method of 1984 computed it for matte surfaces, and path tracing computes it for everything.
b43237bee326.zh: 这些项缩小得有多快？<bookmark mark='a'/>在对数刻度上，每次反弹图像的平均亮度落在一条几乎笔直的线上。<bookmark mark='b'/>从第1次反弹起，每一项是前一项的0.38到0.53倍：一个几何级数，正如算子观点所预言的。每次反弹损失的光，被有颜色的墙吸收了，或者从敞开的正面逃走了。<bookmark mark='c'/>这8幅图加起来，恰好就是收敛的图像。<bookmark mark='d'/>而靠后的项很重要：在从表面到达眼睛的光中，百分之43经历了两次或更多次反弹。一个止步于直接光照的渲染器会把它全部丢掉；1984年的辐射度方法为哑光表面算出了它，而路径追踪为一切算出了它。

287b0c9eb13a.en: The rendering equation is an integral inside an integral, with no end, and Monte Carlo handles that. <bookmark mark='a'/> To estimate an integral, draw directions from any density p, and average the integrand divided by p: Part twenty's method. <bookmark mark='b'/> It is unbiased: under p, the expected value of g over p is exactly the integral. <bookmark mark='c'/> Now take a single sample at each bounce. From the eye the ray meets the back wall; choose one direction at random; it meets the ceiling; again, the matte ball; again, and it reaches the lamp. That is a path. <bookmark mark='d'/> A running weight, the throughput, is multiplied at each bounce by f cos theta over p, <bookmark mark='e'/> and the light the path finds, times its throughput, is one estimate of the pixel. This is path tracing, Kajiya's own algorithm.
287b0c9eb13a.zh: 渲染方程是积分里套着积分，没有尽头，而蒙特卡洛能处理它。<bookmark mark='a'/>要估计一个积分，就从任意一个密度 p 中抽取方向，对被积函数除以 p 取平均：这是第20部分的方法。<bookmark mark='b'/>它是无偏的：在 p 之下，g 除以 p 的期望值恰好就是这个积分。<bookmark mark='c'/>现在在每次反弹时只取一个样本。从眼睛出发，光线遇到后墙；随机选一个方向，它遇到天花板；再选一次，遇到哑光球；再选一次，它到达了灯。这就是一条路径。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个累乘的权重，也就是吞吐量，在每次反弹时乘以 f 乘 cos θ 除以 p，<bookmark mark='e'/>而路径找到的光乘以它的吞吐量，就是对这个像素的一次估计。这就是路径追踪，Kajiya 自己的算法。

00d197a4eb85.en: Which density should we sample? Any works, but the noise depends on the choice. <bookmark mark='a'/> The integrand contains a cosine, so sample more often where the cosine is large, near the normal. <bookmark mark='b'/> Malley's method does this without any trigonometry. Pick points uniformly on a disk, <bookmark mark='c'/> then lift each one straight up onto the hemisphere above it. They crowd towards the top. <bookmark mark='d'/> The disk is the hemisphere seen from above, and a patch of directions d omega appears on it with area cos theta d omega. So the lifted directions have density cos theta over pi. <bookmark mark='e'/> For a matte surface, f cos theta over p is then just the albedo. Every bounce multiplies the throughput by the same number, and the cosine adds no noise at all.
00d197a4eb85.zh: 我们应该按哪个密度采样？哪个都行，但噪声取决于这个选择。<bookmark mark='a'/>被积函数里含有一个余弦，所以要在余弦大的地方，也就是法线附近，更频繁地采样。<bookmark mark='b'/>Malley 的方法不用任何三角函数就做到了这一点。在一个圆盘上均匀地取点，<bookmark mark='c'/>再把每个点竖直向上抬到它上方的半球上。它们挤向顶部。<bookmark mark='d'/>圆盘就是从上方看到的半球，一小块方向 dω 投在它上面的面积是 cos θ dω。所以抬起来的方向的密度是 cos θ 除以 π。<bookmark mark='e'/>对哑光表面，f 乘 cos θ 除以 p 于是就是反照率。每次反弹都把吞吐量乘以同一个数，而余弦完全不带来任何噪声。

9b245e40ec81.en: When should a path stop? Cutting every path at a fixed length drops the later terms of the series: a bias. <bookmark mark='a'/> A path's throughput shrinks at each bounce, so its later terms matter less and less. <bookmark mark='b'/> Russian roulette, brought to graphics by James Arvo and David Kirk in 1990, stops paths at random instead: keep the path with probability q, and if it survives, divide its weight by q. <bookmark mark='c'/> The proof is one line. The expected contribution is q times X over q, plus one minus q times zero: X. <bookmark mark='d'/> The price is some extra variance, growing as q falls. <bookmark mark='e'/> Our tracer plays from the third bounce, with q equal to the throughput, capped at nought point nine five: dim paths usually die, and survivors return to full weight.
9b245e40ec81.zh: 一条路径应该在什么时候停下？在一个固定长度处截断每条路径，会丢掉级数里靠后的项：这是一种偏差。<bookmark mark='a'/>一条路径的吞吐量在每次反弹时都会缩小，所以它靠后的项越来越不重要。<bookmark mark='b'/>俄罗斯轮盘赌由 James Arvo 和 David Kirk 在1990年引入图形学，它改为随机地停止路径：以概率 q 保留这条路径，如果它活下来，就把它的权重除以 q。<bookmark mark='c'/>证明只要一行。期望贡献是 q 乘以 X 除以 q，加上1减 q 乘以零：X。<bookmark mark='d'/>代价是一些额外的方差，q 越小，它越大。<bookmark mark='e'/>我们的追踪器从第三次反弹开始玩这个游戏，q 等于吞吐量，上限为0.95：暗淡的路径通常会死去，而幸存者回到完整的权重。

abe9fa4ad1cb.en: Our light is small, a sixteenth of the ceiling. <bookmark mark='a'/> A path that leaves the floor in a random direction rarely hits it: here, none of nine. The paths that do find it are rare and bright: that is noise. <bookmark mark='b'/> Next-event estimation aims at the light directly. At every matte vertex, pick a point on the lamp and send a shadow ray towards it. <bookmark mark='c'/> Converting area on the light to solid angle at the point gives two cosines over the distance squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> If the shadow ray is clear, add the direct light. <bookmark mark='e'/> Then, so nothing is counted twice, light that a later bounce reaches by chance is ignored, except after a mirror, which a shadow ray cannot aim through.
abe9fa4ad1cb.zh: 我们的光源很小，只占天花板的十六分之一。<bookmark mark='a'/>一条从地板沿随机方向出发的路径很少击中它：这里，九条中有零条。确实找到它的路径稀少而明亮：这就是噪声。<bookmark mark='b'/>下一事件估计直接瞄准光源。在每个哑光顶点上，在灯上取一个点，朝它发出一条阴影光线。<bookmark mark='c'/>把光源上的面积换算成这个点处的立体角，得到两个余弦除以距离的平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>如果阴影光线畅通无阻，就加上直接光。<bookmark mark='e'/>然后，为了不重复计数，后来某次反弹碰巧到达的光会被忽略，只有在镜子之后例外，因为阴影光线无法穿过镜子去瞄准。

486b8e598ce3.en: Light sampling is not always best. <bookmark mark='a'/> With a small light and a broad lobe it is ideal: every sample lands where the integrand lives. <bookmark mark='b'/> But with a large light and a narrow, shiny lobe, most light samples land where the BRDF is nearly zero, and sampling the BRDF is far better. <bookmark mark='c'/> Eric Veach and Leonidas Guibas showed in 1995 how to use both: draw samples from each strategy, and weight every sample. <bookmark mark='d'/> If the weights sum to one in every direction, the combination is unbiased, whatever they are. <bookmark mark='e'/> The balance heuristic weights a sample by its own strategy's density over the sum of all of them, so each region is handled mostly by the strategy that samples it best, and Veach proved it is never much worse than the best single strategy.
486b8e598ce3.zh: 光源采样并不总是最好的。<bookmark mark='a'/>光源小、波瓣宽时，它很理想：每个样本都落在被积函数所在的地方。<bookmark mark='b'/>但光源大、而波瓣又窄又有光泽时，大多数光源样本落在 BRDF 几乎为零的地方，这时对 BRDF 采样要好得多。<bookmark mark='c'/>Eric Veach 和 Leonidas Guibas 在1995年展示了怎样两者兼用：从每种策略中抽取样本，并给每个样本加权。<bookmark mark='d'/>只要在每个方向上权重之和都是1，这个组合就是无偏的，不管权重是什么。<bookmark mark='e'/>平衡启发式给一个样本的权重，是它自己那种策略的密度除以所有策略密度之和，所以每个区域主要由最擅长对它采样的策略来处理，而 Veach 证明了，它永远不会比最好的单一策略差太多。

09c633e83ad4.en: Chapter twelve. Our path tracer, and denoising.
09c633e83ad4.zh: 第十二章：我们的路径追踪器，以及去噪。

56ea14a19825.en: Here is one corner of our render, enlarged: the white ball, the blue ball and the green wall. <bookmark mark='a'/> One path per pixel is speckle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each step multiplies the paths by four, and the time with them, from under three hundredths of a second to over six seconds. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each path is an independent random estimate, and the pixel is their average. <bookmark mark='d'/> The variance of an average of N independent terms is sigma squared over N, <bookmark mark='e'/> so the error falls as one over the square root of N: four times the work halves the noise.
56ea14a19825.zh: 这是我们渲染图的一个角落，放大了：白球、蓝球和绿墙。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个像素一条路径，是一片斑点。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一步把路径数乘以4，时间也跟着增长，从不到0.03秒到6秒多。<bookmark mark='c'/>每条路径都是一个独立的随机估计，而像素是它们的平均值。<bookmark mark='d'/>N 个独立项的平均值，其方差是 σ 的平方除以 N，<bookmark mark='e'/>所以误差按 N 的平方根分之一下降：工作量变成4倍，噪声就减半。

6313506584d1.en: Now the whole image, against a reference of two thousand and forty-eight paths per pixel. <bookmark mark='a'/> On logarithmic axes the error falls on a line. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its slope is minus nought point four six, close to Monte Carlo's minus one half. <bookmark mark='c'/> The last point sits a little high, because the reference is noisy too. <bookmark mark='d'/> Time grows with the paths, so each halving of the error costs four times the time. <bookmark mark='e'/> The rate is fixed; the rest of this chapter attacks the constant, sigma.
6313506584d1.zh: 现在是整幅图像，对照一张每像素2048条路径的参考图。<bookmark mark='a'/>在对数坐标轴上，误差落在一条直线上。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的斜率是负0.46，接近蒙特卡洛的负二分之一。<bookmark mark='c'/>最后一个点稍高一些，因为参考图本身也有噪声。<bookmark mark='d'/>时间随路径数增长，所以误差每减半一次，就要花4倍的时间。<bookmark mark='e'/>收敛速度是固定的；这一章余下的部分，攻击的是那个常数 σ。

f2f0a608d29d.en: Our instrument renders the same image four ways, at sixteen paths per pixel, and scores each by its efficiency: one over the error squared times the time. <bookmark mark='a'/> Cosine sampling with next-event estimation is our default. <bookmark mark='b'/> Uniform hemisphere sampling is about seventy per cent as efficient. <bookmark mark='c'/> Without next-event estimation the small light is found only by chance, and efficiency collapses to about a ninth. <bookmark mark='d'/> Aiming at the light is worth nine times the work; sampling the cosine, about one and a half.
f2f0a608d29d.zh: 我们的仪器用四种方式渲染同一幅图，每像素16条路径，并按效率给每种方式打分：效率是误差的平方乘以时间的倒数。<bookmark mark='a'/>带下一事件估计的余弦采样是我们的默认做法。<bookmark mark='b'/>均匀半球采样的效率大约是它的百分之70。<bookmark mark='c'/>没有下一事件估计，那个小光源就只能碰巧被找到，效率骤降到大约九分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>瞄准光源值9倍的工作量；对余弦采样，大约值1.5倍。

ec0e5f8dae7e.en: The last chapter proved Russian roulette unbiased; now we test it. <bookmark mark='a'/> Twelve renders with roulette and twelve without, both capped at thirty-two bounces. <bookmark mark='b'/> The mean brightness agrees to within one standard error. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pixel by pixel, the differences are the size that noise alone would make: their root mean square z-score is one point nought four. <bookmark mark='d'/> And roulette ends paths early: three point one six rays per path instead of nearly seven, fifty-five per cent fewer, in about half the time.
ec0e5f8dae7e.zh: 上一章证明了俄罗斯轮盘赌是无偏的；现在我们来检验它。<bookmark mark='a'/>12次用轮盘赌的渲染，12次不用，两者都以32次反弹为上限。<bookmark mark='b'/>平均亮度在一个标准误差之内一致。<bookmark mark='c'/>逐像素地看，差异的大小正是单靠噪声就会产生的：它们的 z 分数的均方根是1.04。<bookmark mark='d'/>而轮盘赌让路径早早结束：每条路径3.16条光线，而不是将近7条，少了百分之55，用时大约一半。

576cfa91cdba.en: Our box is all matte, so we test multiple importance sampling where it matters: one glossy point under a round light, thirty-two samples, four thousand times over. <bookmark mark='a'/> Down the grid the glossy lobe narrows; to the right the light grows. <bookmark mark='b'/> Light sampling wins at the top left, wrong by under a fifth of one per cent, but is wrong by ninety-three per cent at the bottom right. <bookmark mark='c'/> BRDF sampling is the reverse: wrong by four hundred and sixty per cent with the tiniest light. <bookmark mark='d'/> The power heuristic is never the single best, but its worst case is eight per cent.
576cfa91cdba.zh: 我们的盒子全是哑光的，所以我们在多重重要性采样真正要紧的地方检验它：一个圆形光源下的一个有光泽的点，32个样本，重复4000次。<bookmark mark='a'/>沿网格往下，有光泽的波瓣变窄；往右，光源变大。<bookmark mark='b'/>光源采样在左上角获胜，误差不到百分之0.2，但在右下角误差达到百分之93。<bookmark mark='c'/>BRDF 采样正好相反：在最小的光源下误差达到百分之460。<bookmark mark='d'/>幂启发式从来不是单独最好的那个，但它最坏的情况是百分之8。

53e26d299859.en: The other way to fight noise is to borrow from the neighbours, with the edge-avoiding à-trous filter of Holger Dammertz and colleagues, from 2010. <bookmark mark='a'/> A pass blends each pixel with twenty-five neighbours under a small, smooth kernel. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each pass spreads the taps twice as far apart, with holes between them: à trous. <bookmark mark='c'/> Three passes, seventy-five taps in all, reach across a square twenty-nine pixels wide. <bookmark mark='d'/> To keep edges, each tap is also weighted by how alike the two pixels are, in colour, normal, albedo and position. <bookmark mark='e'/> And only the light is blurred: divide by the albedo, filter, and multiply it back, so the walls' colours stay sharp.
53e26d299859.zh: 另一种对抗噪声的办法，是向邻居借，用的是 Holger Dammertz 等人2010年提出的边缘避让 à-trous 滤波器。<bookmark mark='a'/>一遍滤波，在一个小而平滑的核下，把每个像素和25个邻居混合。<bookmark mark='b'/>每一遍都把采样点之间的距离拉开一倍，中间留下空洞：à trous 就是“带孔”的意思。<bookmark mark='c'/>三遍，一共75个采样点，覆盖一个29像素宽的正方形。<bookmark mark='d'/>为了保留边缘，每个采样点还要按两个像素有多相似来加权，比较的是颜色、法线、反照率和位置。<bookmark mark='e'/>而且只模糊光照：除以反照率，滤波，再乘回去，这样墙的颜色保持清晰。

b4928e7a83e4.en: Here is the filter on sixteen paths per pixel. <bookmark mark='a'/> Around the balls the speckle is gone, while the edges and soft shadows survive: the error on the surfaces is four times smaller. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the ceiling, lit only indirectly, the noise turns into blotches, error at low frequencies that no filter can tell from real light. <bookmark mark='c'/> Over all pixels the error falls much less, because the noise on the light's own edge is left alone. <bookmark mark='d'/> The filter costs a third of a second, less than the render. But it is biased: it trades noise for blur.
b4928e7a83e4.zh: 这是作用在每像素16条路径上的滤波器。<bookmark mark='a'/>球周围的斑点消失了，而边缘和柔和的阴影保留了下来：表面上的误差小了4倍。<bookmark mark='b'/>在只被间接照亮的天花板上，噪声变成了一块块斑痕，这是低频的误差，任何滤波器都无法把它和真实的光区分开。<bookmark mark='c'/>在全部像素上，误差下降得少得多，因为光源自身边缘上的噪声没有被处理。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个滤波器花三分之一秒，比渲染少。但它是有偏的：它用噪声换来了模糊。

d38ecc4edf2a.en: Chapter thirteen. Curves, surfaces and fonts.
d38ecc4edf2a.zh: 第十三章：曲线、曲面与字体。

ec4f7e2c8b8a.en: Smooth shapes need curves, and the standard one was found twice, at two car makers: by Paul de Casteljau at Citroën in 1959, and by Pierre Bézier at Renault, who published it in the 1960s. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start with four control points. <bookmark mark='b'/> Pick a fraction t. Go that fraction along each leg of the polygon, and join the new points. Repeat until one point is left: that is the curve at t. <bookmark mark='c'/> Sweep t from nought to one, and the point draws the whole curve. At one half, our instrument gives the point two, one point six. <bookmark mark='d'/> The construction gives more. Frozen at one half, the first points of each level are the control points of the curve's left half, and the last points those of its right half. <bookmark mark='e'/> Split until every piece is nearly straight, then draw lines: that is how a renderer draws a curve.
ec4f7e2c8b8a.zh: 光滑的形状需要曲线，而标准的那种曲线被发现了两次，在两家汽车制造商：1959年在雪铁龙的 Paul de Casteljau，以及在雷诺的 Pierre Bézier，他在1960年代发表了它。<bookmark mark='a'/>从四个控制点开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>选一个比例 t。沿控制多边形的每一条边走这个比例，把新得到的点连起来。重复，直到只剩一个点：那就是曲线在 t 处的点。<bookmark mark='c'/>让 t 从0扫到1，这个点就画出整条曲线。在二分之一处，我们的仪器给出的点是（2，1.6）。<bookmark mark='d'/>这个构造给出的还不止这些。冻结在二分之一处，每一层的第一个点，就是曲线左半段的控制点，而每一层的最后一个点，就是右半段的控制点。<bookmark mark='e'/>一直分割，直到每一段都几乎是直的，然后画直线：渲染器就是这样画曲线的。

4bd8db01c6f7.en: What polynomial is the construction computing? <bookmark mark='a'/> One level is a linear interpolation between two points. <bookmark mark='b'/> Two levels nest them, a lerp of lerps. <bookmark mark='c'/> Multiply out, and the quadratic weights are one minus t squared, two t times one minus t, and t squared. <bookmark mark='d'/> Three levels give the cubic, and its four weights are the Bernstein polynomials. <bookmark mark='e'/> They are never negative and always sum to one. So the curve stays inside the convex hull of its control points; it starts and ends on the end points, tangent to the first and last legs; and moving the four points by a matrix moves the curve, so chapter one's transforms act on control points alone.
4bd8db01c6f7.zh: 这个构造在计算的是什么多项式？<bookmark mark='a'/>一层是两点之间的一次线性插值。<bookmark mark='b'/>两层把它们嵌套起来，是线性插值的线性插值。<bookmark mark='c'/>乘开，二次的权重是1减 t 之差的平方、2t 乘以1减 t，以及 t 的平方。<bookmark mark='d'/>三层给出三次曲线，它的四个权重就是 Bernstein 多项式。<bookmark mark='e'/>它们从不为负，而且总和总是1。所以曲线始终在它控制点的凸包之内；它在端点处开始和结束，并与第一条和最后一条边相切；而用一个矩阵移动这四个点，就移动了整条曲线，所以第一章的变换只需作用在控制点上。

40ea4f303e6c.en: Long curves are made of many pieces, and joining Bézier pieces smoothly takes care at every joint. B-splines build the smoothness in. <bookmark mark='a'/> A cubic B-spline makes each piece from four neighbouring control points, with weights from the recursion that Maurice Cox and Carl de Boor published in 1972. Here, seven points make four pieces. <bookmark mark='b'/> Our instrument measures the joins. At each knot the position, the slope and the curvature agree to rounding error, about ten to the minus ten; only the third derivative jumps. The curve is C two. <bookmark mark='c'/> And control is local: move one point, and only the pieces that use it change. <bookmark mark='d'/> Add weights and uneven knots, and these become NURBS, the curves of computer-aided design.
40ea4f303e6c.zh: 长曲线由许多段组成，而要让贝塞尔曲线段光滑地相接，每个接点都得小心处理。B 样条把光滑性内建其中。<bookmark mark='a'/>三次 B 样条的每一段由四个相邻的控制点构成，权重来自 Maurice Cox 和 Carl de Boor 在1972年发表的递推。这里，七个点构成四段。<bookmark mark='b'/>我们的仪器测量了这些接点。在每个节点处，位置、斜率和曲率都在舍入误差之内一致，大约10的负10次方；只有三阶导数会跳变。这条曲线是 C2 的。<bookmark mark='c'/>而且控制是局部的：移动一个点，只有用到它的那些段会改变。<bookmark mark='d'/>加上权重和不均匀的节点，它们就成了 NURBS，计算机辅助设计里的曲线。

4b3f1940f32b.en: Surfaces follow the same idea. In 1978 Edwin Catmull and Jim Clark gave rules that refine any mesh of polygons. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each face gets a point at its centre; each edge gets a point averaged from its two ends and its two faces; <bookmark mark='b'/> and each old vertex moves towards a weighted average of its neighbours.
