Every face becomes quadrilaterals. <bookmark mark='c'/> Applied to a cube, each step multiplies the faces by four, while vertices minus edges plus faces stays two: the surface keeps a sphere's topology. <bookmark mark='d'/> The corners pull in, from one point seven three towards nought point eight six six, the limit an exact formula predicts. <bookmark mark='e'/> The limit surface is smooth almost everywhere, and Pixar first animated a character with such surfaces in its short film Geri's Game, in 1997.
4b3f1940f32b.zh: 曲面遵循同样的想法。1978年，Edwin Catmull 和 Jim Clark 给出了一套规则，可以细化任何多边形网格。<bookmark mark='a'/>每个面在中心得到一个点；每条边得到一个点，由它的两个端点和两个相邻面平均而来；<bookmark mark='b'/>每个旧顶点移向它邻居的一个加权平均。每个面都变成四边形。<bookmark mark='c'/>作用在一个立方体上，每一步把面数乘以4，而顶点数减边数加面数始终是2：这个曲面保持着球面的拓扑。<bookmark mark='d'/>角往里收，从1.73向0.866靠拢，这正是一个精确公式预言的极限。<bookmark mark='e'/>极限曲面几乎处处光滑，而 Pixar 第一次用这样的曲面制作角色动画，是在它1997年的短片《棋逢敌手》（Geri's Game）里。

28c3fb8ab94f.en: And curves are in front of you now. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every letter in this series is an outline made of Bézier curves. Here is the word Light, as Manim draws it from TeX's fonts. <bookmark mark='b'/> The dots are the anchor points where curves meet, and the squares are the control handles; a straight stroke is simply a curve whose handles lie on the line. <bookmark mark='c'/> This word is one hundred and ten cubic curves, and the heading above it is five hundred and thirty-six. <bookmark mark='d'/> PostScript, and the fonts TeX uses, store cubic curves; TrueType stores quadratics. <bookmark mark='e'/> To draw a letter, a rasterizer fills the outline by its winding number, and averages the coverage within each pixel: chapter five's anti-aliasing, so that curves look smooth on a grid of samples.
28c3fb8ab94f.zh: 而曲线此刻就在你眼前。<bookmark mark='a'/>这个系列里的每一个字母，都是由贝塞尔曲线构成的轮廓。这是单词 Light，由 Manim 用 TeX 的字体画出来。<bookmark mark='b'/>圆点是曲线相接处的锚点，方块是控制柄；一笔直线，不过是控制柄落在这条线上的曲线。<bookmark mark='c'/>这个单词由110条三次曲线构成，它上方的标题则是536条。<bookmark mark='d'/>PostScript 以及 TeX 用的字体，存储的是三次曲线；TrueType 存储的是二次曲线。<bookmark mark='e'/>要画一个字母，光栅化器按环绕数填充轮廓，并在每个像素内对覆盖率取平均：这是第五章的抗锯齿，让曲线在由样本组成的网格上看起来也是光滑的。

860d2c1eb9f5.en: Chapter fourteen, the frontier. Can a path tracer run at sixty frames a second?
860d2c1eb9f5.zh: 第十四章：前沿。路径追踪器能以每秒60帧运行吗？

16c011d2422b.en: A film frame can take hours. A game has sixteen milliseconds. <bookmark mark='a'/> The gap is closed first by taking very few samples: here our own image at sixteen paths a pixel, still noisy. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then a denoiser, the edge-aware filter of chapter twelve, smooths the noise guided by each pixel's normal and colour, and its error drops from 0.077 to 0.019, below that of two hundred and fifty-six paths. <bookmark mark='c'/> Real-time renderers add three more ideas: hardware since 2018 that walks bounding volume hierarchies in silicon; algorithms such as ReSTIR, from 2020, that reuse good light samples across neighbouring pixels and frames; and neural networks trained to denoise and upscale.
16c011d2422b.zh: 一帧电影画面可以花上几个小时。一个游戏只有16毫秒。<bookmark mark='a'/>弥合这个差距的第一步，是只取极少的样本：这里是我们自己那幅每像素16条路径的图，仍然有噪声。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后是一个去噪器，也就是第十二章那个感知边缘的滤波器，它在每个像素的法线和颜色引导下把噪声抹平，误差从0.077降到0.019，比256条路径的还低。<bookmark mark='c'/>实时渲染器还加上了另外三个想法：自2018年起，用硅片遍历包围体层次结构的硬件；像2020年的 ReSTIR 那样的算法，在相邻像素和相邻帧之间复用好的光源样本；以及训练来去噪和放大分辨率的神经网络。

cd50e59b4c88.en: The newest idea turns rendering around. <bookmark mark='a'/> In 2020 Ben Mildenhall and colleagues trained a small network that maps a point and a viewing direction to a colour and a density, and rendered it by integrating along each ray, fitted to a few dozen photographs of a real scene. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 2023 Bernhard Kerbl and colleagues replaced the network with millions of small three-dimensional Gaussians, projected and blended by a rasterizer, which runs in real time. <bookmark mark='c'/> What is lost is the physics: there are no explicit materials or lights, so these scenes are hard to edit or relight. <bookmark mark='d'/> Both run this part backwards: given pictures, find the scene, the inverse problem of AI, Built part twenty-two.
cd50e59b4c88.zh: 最新的想法把渲染倒了过来。<bookmark mark='a'/>2020年，Ben Mildenhall 等人训练了一个小网络，把一个点和一个观察方向映射成一种颜色和一个密度，再沿每条光线积分来渲染它，这个网络是根据一个真实场景的几十张照片拟合出来的。<bookmark mark='b'/>2023年，Bernhard Kerbl 等人用数以百万计的小三维高斯函数取代了这个网络，它们由光栅化器投影并混合，能实时运行。<bookmark mark='c'/>失去的是物理：没有显式的材质或光源，所以这些场景很难编辑或重新打光。<bookmark mark='d'/>两者都把这一部分倒着运行：给定图片，求出场景，这就是《人工智能，从零搭建》第22部分的反问题。

3677d504602a.en: Open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Caustics: light focused through glass onto a floor and seen in a mirror is still slow to converge for every known unbiased method. <bookmark mark='b'/> Denoisers with guarantees on the bias they introduce. <bookmark mark='c'/> Inverse rendering that recovers materials and lights, and not just appearance. <bookmark mark='d'/> And a measure of image error that matches what people actually see. <bookmark mark='e'/> This part's research problem asks for an unbiased estimator for those caustic paths whose variance is provably within a constant factor of the best possible.
3677d504602a.zh: 未解的问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>焦散：光穿过玻璃聚焦到地板上，再在镜子里被看到，对每一种已知的无偏方法来说，它收敛起来仍然很慢。<bookmark mark='b'/>对自己引入的偏差有保证的去噪器。<bookmark mark='c'/>能恢复材质和光源、而不只是外观的逆向渲染。<bookmark mark='d'/>还有一种与人们实际看到的相吻合的图像误差度量。<bookmark mark='e'/>这一部分的研究题，要求为那些焦散路径构造一个无偏估计量，并证明它的方差在最优可能值的常数倍之内。

e6d96c5803d3.en: What we built in this part. Transforms as matrices, with quaternions to rotate smoothly; perspective as linear algebra plus one division, and the depth buffer that division distorts. A rasterizer with edge functions and perspective-correct interpolation, shading, and textures sampled without aliasing. A ray tracer, accelerated by bounding volume hierarchies to a logarithm per ray. Radiometry and the rendering equation, solved by a path tracer whose noise falls as one over the square root of the samples, made practical by importance sampling and denoising. And the Bézier curves that draw every letter on screen. One idea runs through it: a picture is an integral, and every technique is a way of estimating it.
e6d96c5803d3.zh: 我们在这一部分构建了什么。作为矩阵的变换，以及用来平滑旋转的四元数；作为线性代数再加一次除法的透视，以及被那次除法扭曲的深度缓冲区。一个光栅化器，带着边函数和透视校正插值、着色，以及没有混叠地采样的纹理。一个光线追踪器，用包围体层次结构加速到每条光线一个对数。辐射度量学与渲染方程，由一个路径追踪器求解，它的噪声按样本数的平方根分之一下降，并靠重要性采样和去噪变得实用。还有画出屏幕上每一个字母的贝塞尔曲线。一个思想贯穿其中：一幅图像是一个积分，而每一种技术都是估计它的一种方法。

11d7bc6c70e5.en: Where this comes back. Part 52 treats integration and linear solvers with the care rounding demands. Part 54 proves programs correct, graphics drivers among them. Part 57 asks when learning from images can generalize. Part 60 builds hardware for one job, and the GPU is the first and most successful example. And Part 61 returns to this part's open problems as research.
11d7bc6c70e5.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再出现。第52部分以舍入所要求的那种细心，处理积分和线性方程组求解器。第54部分证明程序是正确的，图形驱动程序也在其中。第57部分追问从图像中学习什么时候能够泛化。第60部分为单一的一种工作专门构建硬件，而 GPU 是第一个、也是最成功的例子。而第61部分会把这一部分的未解问题当作研究重新拾起。

8c18e84c200b.en: In practice. Game engines rasterize, and add ray-traced shadows and reflections where hardware allows. Graphics programming interfaces such as Vulkan, Metal and WebGPU expose shaders and command buffers. Film is rendered by production path tracers with denoisers, on render farms. Fonts, vector graphics and compositors draw every interface you use. And when a renderer is wrong, look at one sample per pixel: the noise tells you where the light is lost.
8c18e84c200b.zh: 实践中。游戏引擎做光栅化，并在硬件允许的地方加上光线追踪的阴影和反射。Vulkan、Metal 和 WebGPU 这样的图形编程接口，暴露出着色器和命令缓冲区。电影由带去噪器的产品级路径追踪器在渲染农场上渲染。字体、矢量图形和合成器，画出你用的每一个界面。而当一个渲染器出错时，看看每像素一个样本的图：噪声会告诉你光在哪里丢失了。

4e23c9dce43c.en: Six problems, with full solutions in the part's notes. Pause on any of them. The fifth is a build problem: give our path tracer a second light and sample both, then measure the noise. The last, marked with a star, is a research problem: an estimator for caustics whose variance is provably close to the best possible.
4e23c9dce43c.zh: 六道习题，完整解答在这一部分的笔记里。可以在任何一道上暂停。第五道是构建题：给我们的路径追踪器加上第二个光源，并对两个光源都采样，然后测量噪声。最后一道标有星号，是研究题：为焦散构造一个估计量，并证明它的方差接近最优可能值。

8907356cf40f.en: Next time, Part 52: computing with real numbers. With rounding in every operation, which answers can we trust? The answer separates how hard a problem is from how good an algorithm is, and leads to the algorithms that power all of scientific computing.
8907356cf40f.zh: 下一次，第52部分：用实数计算。每一次运算都有舍入，哪些答案可以信任？答案把一个问题有多难，和一个算法有多好区分开来，并引出那些驱动整个科学计算的算法。

9bd24692775d.en: The books and papers this part follows are on screen and in the notes. Thank you for watching.
9bd24692775d.zh: 这一部分所依据的书和论文都在屏幕上和笔记里。感谢观看。
